title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities
  • Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
  • Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
  • Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
  • Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
  • Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
  • Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
  • Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
  • Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
  • Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
  • Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
  • Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background
  • You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
  • You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
  • Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
  • You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
  • You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
  • You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
  • You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities
  • You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
  • You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
  • You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
  • You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
  • You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer
  • A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
  • A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
  • The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
  • Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
  • An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
  • Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.


Practical information

Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
Employment: Permanent position.

Application
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

title: Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor in Defense-related Technologies for Unmanned Aerial Systems Engineering for Defense
description:
SDU Drone Center at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense invites applications for positions in defense-related technologies for Drones (Unmanned Aerial Systems, UAS) at the levels of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor. The positions are available from January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

What we offer
The successful candidate(s) will join the SDU Drone Center, located at SDU Campus and at HCA Airport, where we operate state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor drone laboratories. You will become part of an interdisciplinary and agile research environment with strong ties to the internationally recognized robotics ecosystem in Odense.

 

What We expect
We expect candidates to have documented expertise in systems engineering for unmanned aerial systems with demonstrated real-world applications. The successful candidate will conduct research in aerial robotics, focusing on the design and implementation of drones operating in dynamic and complex outdoor environments. Relevant research areas include, but are not limited to, autonomous systems, swarming, navigation in GNSS-denied environments, communication and coordination, airspace situational awareness and management, safety and security, and counter-drone technologies.

Experience in defense-related research and/or applications is considered an advantage.

 

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must have:

  • Strong research and publication record;

  • Experience with defense, industrial, public sector and/or emergency services collaboration (this is a requirement for Full Professor);

  • Proven track record of attracting research funding (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor);

  • Experience with teaching and education development (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor).

The successful candidate(s) are expected to play a proactive role in contributing to and expanding the Center’s research portfolio. This includes active participation in ongoing projects as well as the development, leadership, and coordination of new externally funded research initiatives. The candidate(s) are further expected to secure competitive national and international research funding, establish strategic collaborations with academic, industrial, and defense stakeholders, and strengthen the Center’s position in civil and defense-related drone technologies.

The candidate(s) will contribute to teaching and supervision within the Master of Science education in Drones and Autonomous Systems, which is part of the Robotics MSc programme at the University of Southern Denmark.

Research environment
SDU Drone Center conducts research in drone technologies and future drone applications within areas such as defense, infrastructure inspection, healthcare logistics, precision agriculture, nature conservation, and environmental monitoring. We are an interdisciplinary team of researchers with specializations within robotics, computer vision, software, embedded systems, and the design and construction of drone systems. Together we create drone solutions for a flourishing European society. Learn more about the center at https://www.sdu.dk/uasFor further information please contact Head of SDU Drone Center, Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, ups@mmmi.sdu.dk,  phone: +45 6550 3570.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration (mandatory for full professor and associate professor applicants).

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience (for assistant professor applicants).

  • Research plan.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and appointment as an associate professor and full professor is permanent. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an associate professor and full professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor or a full professor. A completed lecturer training programme or equivalent pedagogical/didactical competence development is a prerequisite. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, associate professor or full professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Postdoc Position in Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute, The University of Southern Denmark in Sønderborg, Denmark
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a postdoctoral research associate in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and (Photo)electrochemistry, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, a part of MCI, and it is integrated into the novel, active working group CatMatX, a research laboratory focused on developing next-generation catalytic materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications,  by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing project proposals to support research at SDU NanoSYD. 

Job Description and Responsibilities

  • Implementation of research tasks related to the project;

  • Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, and evaluation of materials performance in solar water splitting;

  • Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results;

  • Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.;

  • Publishing of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals with high impact factors.

Potential Responsibilities 

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics; 

  • Assistance in teaching activities; 

  • Assistance in setting up the research infrastructure;

  • Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding. 

Mandatory qualifications 

  • PhD degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, Electrochemistry, or related fields; 

  • Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds;

  • Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM);   

  • Proven track record of publishing in international peer-reviewed scientific journals as leading author;

  • Fluency in English (both spoken and written);

  • Ability to work in teams and also independently; 

  • Strong communication skills; 

  • Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry. 

The following qualifications are advantageous

  • Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities, DFT calculations and MD simulations;

  • Research experience in electrochemistry and solar water splitting; 

  • Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project; 

  • Proven record in participating in national and international research projects;

  • Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group.

Contact information

For more information about the department and the position, please contact Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk) and Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and it starts on 01.03.2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

To qualify for the position as postdoc you must have obtained a PhD degree by the employment date. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • One-page motivation letter that describes the applicant’s previous research work and experience most relevant to the offered position.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Certificates/Diplomas (Bachelor, Master, and PhD degrees) – Danish and/or English transcripts. 

  • Complete list of publications (please highlight publications most relevant to the offered position).

  • Research statement on developing novel transition metal-based mixed anion compounds, particularly (oxy)nitrides, for solar water splitting.

  • A reference letter may be submitted, but is not required. 

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is October 31, 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST).

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. title: Senior Controller
description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.

* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.

Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. title: Server
description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:

- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.

Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

title: Senior Controller
description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others and explain complex financial information to people who are not finance specialists. Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

We offer: By joining us, you will become part of an organisation with a diverse and inclusive work culture that supports you in discovering new perspectives and developing professionally.
You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future. To help you perform your work safely and feel well, we support both your physical and mental wellbeing. This is a permanent position with an open-ended employment contract. How to Apply You can submit your application to us only in English, using our recruitment system. We hope to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 24 September. If you have any questions, please contact our People and Culture representative, Alena Stesnerova, at alena.stesnerova[at]storaenso.com.

title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas.
Seoses suvise hooaja ja suurenenud töömahuga otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks või hooajaliseks tööks suveperioodil. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

title: Automaalari ja koripeltiseppä

AUTOMAALAREITA JA KORIPELTISEPPÄÄ

Etsimme tällä haulla ainoastaan valmiita ja itsenäiseen työhön kykeneviä alan asiantuntijoita. Jos sinulla ei ole alan ammatillista taustaa ja käytännön kokemusta korjaamo- tai maalaamotyöstä, ethän jätä hakemusta. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme kattavasti kaikissa ajoneuvojen koritöissä, kolarikorjauksissa, hitsauksissa sekä vaativissa maalauspalveluissa. Henkilöautojen lisäksi erikoisosaamiseemme kuuluvat raskaan kaluston, veneiden sekä teollisuus- ja ratikkaosien kori- ja maalaustyöt. Odotamme sinulta: B-ajokortti (ehdottomasti välttämätön): Sinulla on oltava voimassa oleva ajokortti ajoneuvojen siirtoja, hallinhallintaa ja koeajoja varten. Vahvaa ammattitaitoa maalaamossa: Hallitset suvereenisti pohjatyöt (hionnat, kittaustyöt, suojaukset), pintamaalauksen, lakkauksen sekä haastavat häivytysmaalaukset. Väriosaamista: Kokemus digitaalisten väriskannerien käytöstä ja sävytarkkuudesta on välttämätöntä. Peltisepän ja kolarikorjauksen taitoja: Kokemusta peltiosien oikaisusta, korirakenteiden korjauksista, purku-/asennustöistä sekä varmasta hitsausosaamisesta (MIG/MAG). Cabas-osaaminen (suuri plussa): Kyky tehdä tai ymmärtää vakuutusyhtiöiden Cabas-vahinkotarkastuslaskelmia katsotaan merkittäväksi eduksi. Mitä tarjoamme? Vakituisen työpaikan vakaassa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä (työsopimukseen sovelletaan lakisääteistä 6 kk koeaikaa). Kilpailykykyisen, osaamisesi ja ammattitaitosi mukaisen palkan.(Palkka sovitaan kokemuksen mukaan) Laadukkaat materiaalit sekä nykyaikaiset laitteet ja olosuhteet työn tekemiseen. Miten haet? title: Library Events, Development and Partnerships Coordinator
description:
**General Mission**

The Coordinator is responsible for the development and programming of the library. They organise activities and events, develop partnerships, and contribute to the librarys visitor numbers.

They are also responsible for monitoring the collections, handling returned books, and keeping the library organised.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Library Programming and Development**

- Increase the librarys visitor numbers and appeal, taking into account the expectations and needs of its audiences.

- Promote the librarys spaces and collections by developing projects and events.

- Develop a range of paid activities and services.

- Manage the library shop and coffee area.


**2\. Talks and Debates**

- Design and organise talks, debates, lectures and events.

- Identify and invite authors, experts, associations and other relevant speakers or personalities.

- Encourage discussion, participation and interaction among different audiences.


**3\. Partnerships and Collaborations**

- Identify, develop and maintain a network of partners.

- Build partnerships and joint projects with external organisations and stakeholders.


**4\. Library Space and Collection Management**

- Ensure the efficient day-to-day operation of the library and report any issues or malfunctions.

- Handle returned books and ensure that materials are properly shelved and organised.

- Maintain the collections, including classification, presentation, repairs and replacement of damaged or missing items.

- Select and order new books and other materials.


**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dynamic, independent and curious person who is proactive and enjoys interacting with the public. The successful candidate will play an active role in the cultural and commercial development of a welcoming and open community space.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and confidence in interacting with the public and partners.

- Ability to create and develop partnerships.

- Initiative and ability to propose and deliver projects.

- Commercial awareness and ability to identify potential sources of funding.

- Strong organisational skills, autonomy and versatility.

- A passion for reading, discussion and the exchange of ideas.


**Practical Information**

- Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, renewable

- Working hours: 80%, spread over 4 days per week

- **Salary :** €2,268 gross per month

- Start date : October 2026

- Languages: English at C1 level required; French at B2 level preferred; Knowledge of Finnish is an advantage.

- How to apply: Please send your CV along with a short cover letter to **sg-ac@france.fi by 27 September.**

- If you have not heard from us within 4 weeks, please consider that your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Hydrauliikka-asentaja, laivateollisuus
description:
Etsimme hydrauliikka-asentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun! Asiakasyrityksemme on erikoistunut laivateollisuuteen ja he tarjoavat kattavasti hydrauliikkahuolto- ja korjauspalveluita toimipisteellään, telakoilla ja aluksilla.

Pääasiallisena tehtävänäsi on toimia asentajana hydrauliikkaan liittyvissä huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä esim. letkujen valmistus sekä huolto. Tehtäviä voi olla aika ajoin myös sylinterityöt, öljyjen vaihto tai vaativammatkin korjaustyöt. Töitä tehdään kokoaikaisesti 37,5h/viikko ja odotamme hakijalta reissuvalmiutta, sillä töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä, telakoilla ja aluksilla. Reissujen pituudet vaihtelevat aina muutamasta päivästä pariin viikkoon riippuen telakasta/aluksesta ja tämän sijainnista, mutta useimmiten nämä sijaitsevat Suomessa tai muualla Euroopassa. Ajoittaisen ulkomaanreissaamisen vuoksi edellytämme sinulta vähintään kohtalaista englannin kielen osaamista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Aikaisempi tehtävään soveltuva koulutus esim. raskaan kaluston koulutus, hydrauliikka ja/tai työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta.

\- Oman ajoneuvon käyttömahdollisuutta asiakasyrityksen sijainnin vuoksi ja lisäksi C-ajokortti lasketaan eduksi.

\- Reissuvalmiutta aina muutamasta päivästä muutamaan viikkoon asti ajoittain.

title: Kundskapsledningsexpert (Borgå)
description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker en KUNSKAPSLEDNINGSEXPERT för en visstidsanställning för tiden 1.10.2026 – 31.12.2027. Arbetet placerar sig i början vid enheten för digitala tjänster inom koncern- och strategitjänsterna, i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik.**

Enheten för digitala tjänster erbjuder ICTtjänster och ansvarar för utvecklingen av digitala tjänster inom hela välfärdsområdet. Du arbetar i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik tillsammans med andra experter inom digitala tjänster och verksamheten.

Vårt team ansvarar för välfärdsområdets kunskapsbaserade ledning, datalagret och rapporteringslösningarna. Datalagret tar emot data från flera olika patient och kunddatasystem samt bl.a. från ekonomi och personaladministrativa system.

Som kunskapsledningsexpert fungerar du som huvudanvändare för datalagret samt för andra teknologier för kunskapsbaserad ledning. Du säkerställer att datalagerlösningen betjänar välfärdsområdets behov, är nationellt kompatibel och leverantörsoberoende. Du deltar i modelleringen av datalagrets data samt i att producera, utveckla och upprätthålla rapportering. Datalagret är ett Azure Databricks-datalager och rapporteringen genomförs med Power BI. Modelleringen görs med SQL- och Pythonspråk.

Datagrunden består av kund- och patientuppgifter, ekonomiförvaltningens uppgifter, personalförvaltningens uppgifter samt andra uppgifter som är väsentliga med tanke på välfärdsområdets verksamhet. Huvuddelen av uppgifterna har modellerats enligt medaljongarkitekturen. Som expert inom kunskapsbaserad ledning förstår du data och hur data kan utnyttjas för att uppnå organisationens mål. Du är med och definierar informationsbehov tillsammans med ledningen och genomför dem via datalagret till rapporterna.

Din centrala uppgift är att utveckla utnyttjandet av datalagerlösningen och produktiviteten tillsammans med vårt team. Datagrunden ska framöver möjliggöra utvecklingen av analytik, maskininlärning och artificiell intelligens samt förbättra produktiviteten och kvaliteten i välfärdsområdets tjänster. Den exakta arbetsbeskrivningen formas enligt den valda personens kompetensområden.

Företagshälsovården handhas av Mehiläinen. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta på distans enligt överenskommelse.

**Behörighetskrav:**

- En högskoleexamen som lämpar sig för uppgiften

- Som språkkrav krävs utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i det ena inhemska språket och goda muntliga kunskaper i det andra


**Vi förväntar oss dessutom:**

- Arbetserfarenhet av datalagerlösningar och/eller av att utnyttja stora datamängder i arbetet

- God samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av självständigt arbete inom kunskapsbaserat ledning, rapportering eller ICTutveckling och underhåll


**Vi uppskattar:**

- arbetserfarenhet och kunskaper av kunskapsbaserade ledningens uppgifter

- förmåga att lära sig snabbt

- kännedom om nationella riktlinjer för kund och patientdata inom social och hälsovården

- kunskaper i Azure Databricks, Power BI, SQL- och Pythonspråk


Anställningsvillkoren följer VÄLKA. Arbetet är dagarbete och veckoarbetstiden är 36 h 15 min. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 4290,9 euro/mån samt eventuella tillägg. Prövotiden är sex månader. Sökanden måste ge sitt samtycke till att en säkerhetsutredning genomförs.

Skicka in din ansökan senast 4.10.2026 kl. 23:59. Mer information ges av kunskapsledningschef Mervi Makkonen, tfn 040 152 8109 tai mervi.makkonen@itauusimaa.fi

Vid tillsättandet av uppgiften beaktas i första hand de anställda som sagts upp av produktionsmässiga och ekonomiska skäl inom Östra Nylands välfärdsområde, förutsatt att de uppfyller behörighetskraven för uppgiften.

title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance
Interested?

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

More information arja.martikainen@barona.fi

title: Project Manager, Industrial projects
description:
Do you want to lead industrial investment projects that contribute to a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Managers to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will manage demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from project development and engineering through implementation, commissioning and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
At Sweco, you will work closely with clients, contractors, system and equipment suppliers, designers and Swecos multidisciplinary project organisation. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility for impactful projects while being supported by a strong network of experts.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and at least five years of experience in demanding industrial project delivery. This is not a discipline-specific project management role: you have experience leading broad, multidisciplinary project organisations and coordinating interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
You are able to manage the overall delivery of a complex industrial project, including scope, schedule, budget, risks, reporting and stakeholder collaboration. You can coordinate several technical disciplines and delivery partners, identify and resolve interface issues, and keep the project moving forward towards its objectives.
We expect you to have:
- At least five years of relevant experience in industrial project management or project delivery.
- Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary industrial projects during the implementation phase; experience with EPCM or similar industrial project delivery models is an advantage.
- Understanding of industrial project development, engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
- Strong stakeholder-management, communication and collaboration skills.
- Fluent written and spoken English; proficiency in Finnish and/or Swedish is an advantage.

What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Interested?
Please submit your application via the link provided by Monday, 19 October 2026. We review applications and start initial discussions already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

ville.mykra@sweco.fi

title: Service Engineer
description:
**Location: Vantaa, Finland**

At ADB SAFEGATE, we are shaping the future of airport performance. Our solutions help airports operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably — from aircraft approach to gate departure.

To strengthen our service team in Finland, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on **Service Engineer** to support our customers with advanced airport technology solutions.

**Your Mission**

In this role, you will be an important part of our technical team, ensuring that mission-critical airport systems are commissioned, maintained, and supported to the highest standards.

You will:

- Perform servicing, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and diagnostics of ADB SAFEGATE hardware and software systems, both on-site and remotely.

- Maintain and update technical documentation.

- Provide technical expertise and support to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders while independently taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Conduct on-site surveys and prepare technical reports.

- Represent ADB SAFEGATE professionally in all customer interactions.


**Your Profile**

We are looking for a practical, ambitious, and reliable professional who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership in an international environment.

**Required qualifications**

- A degree or professional qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Computer Science, IT, or a comparable technical field.

- Hands-on experience with electrical, automation, control, or industrial IT systems, including confidence in using technical tools, test equipment, and diagnostic software.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify faults across hardware, software, electrical, and control systems.

- Practical experience with low- or medium-voltage equipment and the ability to read electrical drawings and wiring diagrams.

- Professional working proficiency in Finnish and English, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and international colleagues.

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, including occasional short-notice assignments. Some commissioning and service activities may take place outside standard working hours.

- A valid Category B driving licence and willingness to travel independently to customer sites.

- Ability to manage assigned service and commissioning tasks independently while collaborating effectively with international engineering, project, and customer support teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to provide professional technical support, guidance, and updates.

- A proactive and responsible approach, with strong quality awareness, customer focus, and ownership of assigned tasks.


**Preferred qualifications**

- Previous experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, System Engineer, Service Technician, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.

- Experience with airport systems, airfield lighting, industrial infrastructure, or other safety- or operationally critical systems.

- Practical knowledge of PLC systems, switchgear, control equipment, and industrial automation.

- Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows and/or Linux operating systems.

- Working knowledge of SQL databases, including basic diagnostics, queries, and system support.

- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages used for diagnostics, configuration, automation, or system integration, such as Python, Bash, batch scripting, C#, or JavaScript.

- Experience with cloud-connected systems, remote monitoring solutions, networking, or remote support tools.

- A relevant Finnish electrical safety qualification. Candidates who are eligible and willing to obtain the required qualification may also be considered.

- Knowledge of other European languages.


**What We Offer**

At **ADB SAFEGATE**, you will join an innovative industry leader where your work directly contributes to safer and smarter airport operations worldwide.

**We offer:**

- A role in a global company setting benchmarks in airport safety, efficiency, and technology.

- A dynamic work environment with challenging and meaningful projects.

- International cooperation with experienced colleagues and customers.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and modern working models.

- The friendly atmosphere of a medium-sized company combined with the strength of a global organization.

- Opportunities for personal development, technical training, and professional growth.

- Opportunities to work on customer projects in Finland and across Europe.

- A varied, practical, and engaging role where no two days are the same.


**Ready to Help Airports Move Smarter?**

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on fieldwork, and want to be part of an international team delivering critical airport solutions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join ADB SAFEGATE and help shape the future of safe, efficient, and sustainable airport operations.**

title: Project Director, Industrial projects
description:
Are you ready to lead complex industrial investment projects that shape a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Directors to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will lead demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from early project development through execution and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
As a Project Director, you will take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of large and demanding industrial investment projects, or broader project portfolios. You will lead the project at a strategic and commercial level, from early project development through execution, commissioning and handover.
We are looking for senior professionals with strong experience in leading project delivery, building high-performing project organisations and working closely with clients and partners. At Sweco, you will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on major industrial investments together with leading experts across disciplines.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and 10+ years of experience in senior project leadership roles. You have a proven track record of successfully delivering industrial investment projects and strong experience in EPCM, PMC, Owner's Engineering or similar industrial project delivery environments.
You are an experienced project leader with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, build and develop high-performing project organisations, and manage complex interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning. You are comfortable leading large project organisations, managing schedules, budgets, risks and commercial matters, and working effectively with clients and diverse stakeholders.
You communicate and negotiate confidently in English; Finnish and/or Swedish skills are an advantage.
Experience from projects within process industries, energy, manufacturing, mining, chemicals and data centres is particularly valued.
What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Interested?
Please submit your application via the link provided by Monday, 19 October 2026. We review applications and start initial discussions already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more information about the role, salary or working at Sweco, please contact:
Ville Mykrä
ville.mykra@sweco.fi
Please submit your application through the application form. Due to GDPR requirements, we do not process or store job applications sent by email.

title: Lähihoitaja, sosiaalihuollon resurssiyksikkö, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
description:
Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja motivoituneita lähihoitajia varahenkilöstöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vammaispalveluun, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut sekä vanhuspalveluun. Tarvitsemme tiimiimme joustavia ja sopeutuvia ammattilaisia, jotka pystyvät tukemaan yksiköitämme äkillisissä sijaistarpeissa.

Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!


Kelpoisuusvaatimus:
Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja. Lisäksi valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2. mom. tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

title: Auraaja
description:
Haemme auraajia talvikaudelle Helsingin ja Vantaan alueella sijaitseviin omiin asiakaskohteisiimme.

Työ on kutsuttaessa tehtävää lumenaurausta. Työvuorot määräytyvät sää- ja lumiolosuhteiden mukaan, joten kuljettajalta edellytetään hyvää tavoitettavuutta ja valmiutta lähteä töihin tarvittaessa myös aikaisin aamulla, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

title: Project Procurement Manager
description:
Join us in building a sustainable society powered by clean energy and reliable connections! We are now looking for Project Procurement Manager in Helsinki or Rauma. The position can also be based in any of our other offices in Finland. We offer flexible hybrid working opportunities.

As a Project Procurement Manager, you play a critical role in ensuring successful project delivery. You are responsible for planning and executing procurement activities throughout the project lifecycle, from customer tendering and project kick-off to final delivery and close-out.

Working closely with project teams, category management, suppliers, and business stakeholders, you ensure that projects have the right suppliers, materials, subcontractors, and services available at the right time, cost, and quality. Through proactive procurement leadership, supplier management, and risk mitigation, you contribute directly to project profitability, schedule performance, delivery reliability, and customer satisfaction.

Tasks and responsibilities:
* Lead end-to-end procurement planning and execution
* Act as the main procurement contact for project stakeholders
* Manage sourcing processes (supplier selection, RFQs, negotiations, contracts)
* Ensure optimal total cost of ownership and savings
* Monitor supplier performance and manage supplier issues, claims, and onboarding
* Build and maintain key supplier relationships
* Oversee purchase orders, deliveries, and logistics
* Ensure accurate procurement data in ERP systems
* Identify and mitigate procurement risks
* Ensure compliance with policies, contracts, and regulations
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails
* Integrate ESG and sustainability into sourcing decisions and promote responsible supplier practices

Requirements:
* Relevant degree (e.g. Supply Chain, Business, Engineering)
* 5+ years of procurement experience in project-based environments
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution
* Fluent in English and Finnish

Are you up for the challenge? Come and create the best customer experiences with us!

The application period ends on 11.10.2026. However, please send your application as soon as possible, as we may begin interviews during the application period and fill the position once the right candidate is found.

For more information about the position, please contact: Jonna Katavisto, Talent Acquisition Partner, +358 44 360 6783, jonna.katavisto@enersense.com. Call times Thu 24.9. between 11-12 and Thu 1.10. between 9-10.
