title: Event Setup & Dismantling Crew – 3 people
description:
Event: Talent Boost Summit 2026

Location: Finlandia Hall, Helsinki

Date: Wednesday, 7 October 2026

Workers needed: 3

I am looking for three reliable and hands-on people to help with the setup and dismantling of Talent Boost Summit 2026 at Finlandia Hall.

I am responsible for the spatial design and art curation of the event. The crew will work directly with me to unload, build and arrange the event spaces in the morning, and dismantle and reload everything after the event.

Working hours:

Morning setup: 05:00–08:00 (3 hours)

- Unload furniture, artworks, decoration materials and other equipment from the van

- Carry everything from the loading area into the venue

- Set up stages according to prepared layouts

- Arrange lounge and networking areas

- Position furniture, rugs, plants and decorative elements

- Assist with artworks and visual installations where needed

- Make final adjustments so everything is ready before the event begins


Evening dismantling: 18:00–20:00 (2 hours)

- Dismantle the event setups

- Collect and carefully pack decoration materials and artworks

- Move furniture and materials back to the loading area

- Load everything into the van

- Make sure all materials are collected and accounted for


Total working time: 5 hours.

Workers are welcome to stay at Finlandia Hall during the event (08:30–18:00). This is optional and is not part of the paid working hours. Lunch will be provided for those who stay.

Compensation:

€20/hour × 5 hours = €100 per person.

Payment can be made against an invoice or as work compensation using a tax card.

What Im looking for:

The work is physical and hands-on, so you should be comfortable carrying furniture, boxes and event materials.

You should be reliable and punctual, physically able to carry and move furniture, careful when handling artworks and other materials, and comfortable following instructions and floor plans.

Previous experience with event setup, exhibitions, moving, furniture installation, construction, theatre/film sets or similar work is useful but not required.

Most importantly, I need people who can work efficiently as a team and are comfortable jumping in wherever needed. This is more than an unloading job: we will be building the different event areas together according to the spatial design.

title: Process Engineer for Gold Projects, Metallurgy / Metso Finland Oy, Espoo
description:
About the role

This role is to support Metso's gold projects within the hydrometallurgy sector. The role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop your skills in global industrial projects, whether you are early in your engineering career or already have a few years of experience.

What We Offer
- Dedicated onboarding support from HR and continuous technical mentorship from senior team members.
- A collaborative environment within an established global project team based at our Espoo office.

Work tasks
- Provide process engineering support for gold execution projects, focusing on hydrometallurgy sections.
- Assist in developing core process documentation, including:
- Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
- Mass balances and equipment lists
- Process descriptions and functional specifications
- Collaborate closely with project management, the broader engineering team, and a dedicated team member who will mentor and guide you through daily work.

We are looking for

- Educational Background: Degree in Process Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related field.
- Key Personal Attributes: Organized, reliable, and proactive worker with strong multitasking skills.
- Language Skills: Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory. Finnish language skills are considered a benefit.
- Location: Possibility to work at the office in Espoo.

It is a plus, if you already have some relevant working experience (e.g. process engineering or even experience with gold projects). However, we are open to more junior candidate profiles as well as we will support your onboarding and technical development.

 

 

Our recruitment process

title: Junior IT Service Manager / IT Service Manager for energy sector, Espoo
description:
About the role

In this role, you will work closely with a Senior Manager while collaborating with a team of specialists to ensure system reliability. You will gain hands-on experience and take ownership of daily operational processes for a critical SaaS-based Customer Information System (CIS). This position offers an ideal stepping stone for anyone looking to build a successful career in IT service management.

You are offered
- Gain valuable, practical experience managing operations for a large-scale enterprise Customer Information System.

- Enjoy modern working methods, competitive benefits, and a balance of team collaboration and independent work.

- Cross-Team & Vendor Coordination: Drive daily operational activities, facilitate testing, and coordinate tasks between internal specialists and external service providers.
- Service Management & Documentation: Maintain accurate IT service documentation in Confluence, support audit and compliance checks, and assist the Senior Manager with ad-hoc coordination tasks.

We are looking for

- Relevant higher education degree (e.g., Business Information Technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or similar).
- Previous practical experience in IT or software environments—such as hands-on project experience, acting as a Key User, or serving as a Scrum Master.
- Basic understanding of IT service management (ITSM) concepts and SaaS operational models.
- Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills in English.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Trustful

- Responsible

Our recruitment process

title: PART-TIME CASHIER / WAITER
description:
**Shanghai Taste** is looking for a **part-time Cashier / Waiter** to join our team in the heart of Helsinki.

We are looking for a **friendly, energetic and customer-oriented person** who enjoys working in a fast-paced restaurant environment and genuinely wants to help customers.

Your responsibilities include:

- Welcoming and serving customers in a friendly manner

- Taking customer orders and handling payments

- Helping customers and explaining our menu and products

- Sales and recommending products to customers

- Serving food and drinks

- Keeping the dining area clean and organized

- Cleaning tables and restaurant areas

- Other daily restaurant tasks


We expect you to have:

- At least **1–2 years of customer service experience**

- Excellent and friendly **customer service skills**

- A genuine desire to help customers and create a great customer experience

- A **sales-oriented mindset** and the ability to recommend products naturally

- Good **stress tolerance and ability to work under pressure**

- The ability to work efficiently during busy periods

- **Quick problem-solving skills** and the ability to make decisions independently

- A proactive and responsible attitude

- Reliability and good teamwork skills

- A valid **Hygiene Passport** (required)

- **Alcohol Serving Passport** is considered a plus

- Good **Finnish and English skills**

- **Chinese language skills** are considered an advantage


Working hours

- Part-time position

- **2–5 shifts per week**

- Shifts are mainly between **11:00 and 20:00**

- Working hours can be arranged flexibly


Training provided

**Full training will be provided for the position**, so you do not need to know all of our procedures from day one.

What matters most to us is a **positive attitude, willingness to learn, good customer service and the ability to work as part of a team**.

Employment

- **4-month probationary period**

- After the probationary period, the employment will continue as a **permanent, open-ended employment relationship**, provided that the cooperation is successful and the position is a good fit for both sides.


We are looking for the right attitude

Working in a restaurant can sometimes be very busy. That is why we value someone who can **stay calm under pressure, handle stressful situations and find quick solutions when problems arise**.

You don't need to know everything immediately. We expect you to **take responsibility, ask questions when needed and always try to find a good solution for the customer**.

For us, great customer service means more than simply taking an order. We want someone who **communicates warmly with customers, understands their needs and is comfortable with sales and making recommendations**.

**Location:** Shanghai Taste, Helsinki

**Interested?** Please send us your CV and a short application introducing yourself, your previous customer service experience, language skills and when you would be available to start.

title: Distance Technologies: Data Collection Driver
description:
**Type:** Part-time, fixed term

**Location:** John Stenbergin ranta 2, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** 1.10.2026

Drive, collect real-world data and help develop next-generation technology designed to make vehicles safer and smarter.

**What will you be doing?**

Distance Technologies is looking for a part-time Data Collection Driver to support the development of its next-generation display technologies. Your main responsibility is to drive a Distance-provided car and collect camera and sensor data in different environments around the capital area. The data is used by Distances R&D teams to develop technologies such as depth estimation, positioning, and latency compensation, so your drives might take you from city streets and highways to forest roads in varying conditions.

Based on requests from the engineering team, you will plan suitable routes, operate pre-made data collection scripts from a laptop, and verify that the cameras and sensors are working properly. During the drive, you will troubleshoot basic technical issues independently, such as Wi-Fi, cable, USB device or storage problems. After each drive, you will check and upload the recordings and document the driving conditions and any unexpected events.

**What makes you a great fit?**

This role suits you if you are looking for a flexible part-time role, where you can combine driving with an interest in technology and gain experience in a real R&D environment. The role can fit well alongside technical studies, but relevant skills and curiosity may just as well come from work experience, projects or hobbies.

You are comfortable with computers, enjoy solving practical problems and can work independently based on technical instructions. What matters is a reliable approach to driving, technical curiosity, and willingness to learn.

**We expect you to have:**

- A valid Category B driving license and responsible driving skills

- Recent and regular driving experience in both urban environments and varying road conditions in Finland

- Good computer skills and confidence following technical instructions

- Ability to troubleshoot basic issues with Wi-Fi, USB devices, cables, storage and similar equipment

- Reliable and independent approach to your work

- Good English skills


**We consider as an asset:**

- Familiarity with Linux

- Experience with cameras, lenses, focusing, sensors, or similar equipment

- Basic scripting skills, such as automating a file transfer

- Familiarity with computer vision or related technologies


**We can offer you:**

- Chance to build valuable technical experience in a flexible entry-level role that can fit alongside your studies or other commitments

- Opportunity to join a growing deep tech company developing new technology for global automotive and defense applications

- Environment to improve vehicle safety, seeing how the data you collect contributes directly to its development

- Hands-on experience with advanced cameras, sensors, and test equipment while learning how deep tech products are developed

- Opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers, giving you practical exposure to computer vision and sensor development


**Practicalities:**

This is a part-time (16-32,5h/month) and fixed term position until 31.1.2027. Working hours are flexible and agreed based on data collection needs. As data collection depends on suitable weather conditions, scheduled shifts may occasionally need to be rescheduled at short notice due to weather. We therefore hope that you are flexible regarding working days and hours. In this role you will be employed directly as a aTalent employee at Distance Technologies. Start time is as soon as possible. The role will be located in Helsinki. Salary in this position is 18,00-22,00 €/hour depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Recruitment process timeline:**

- Initial interviews with aTalent: week 41

- Interview rounds with Distance Technologies: week 42

- Final decisions and selections: week 43

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our Marketing & Communications team in Helsinki and shape how customers discover, engage with, and experience Bluefors across digital channels. In this role, you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to strengthen our digital presence, develop demand generation, and turn marketing activities into measurable commercial impact. Interested? Keep reading!

You will take ownership of Bluefors' digital marketing activities, channels, technologies, and performance. As a member of the Marketing & Communications team, you will help ensure that customers can easily discover and engage with Bluefors through a connected digital ecosystem. Working closely with Sales, other customer-facing teams, and IT, you will plan and optimize campaigns, develop our website and social media presence, and use analytics to continuously improve engagement, conversion, and marketing effectiveness.

We are looking for a data-driven digital marketing professional who can translate business and commercial priorities into clear actions. You combine a strong understanding of digital channels with experience in marketing automation, lead management, campaign execution, and performance measurement. You are comfortable working across teams and systems, can move between strategic planning and practical implementation, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Success in this role requires curiosity, collaboration, and a strong continuous improvement mindset. You actively seek opportunities to improve ways of working, enhance digital performance, and create better customer experiences.

Experience from technology, engineering, scientific, industrial, or other highly technical B2B environments is considered an advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, CRM integrations, SEO, generative engine optimization, account-based marketing, AI-enabled marketing tools, and agency or technology partner management would be an additional asset. This experience can help you accelerate the impact of our digital marketing activities and contribute to the continued development of our digital ecosystem.

We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position with the support of a highly skilled growth organization. This is an excellent opportunity to build a scalable digital marketing ecosystem and grow professionally in a dynamic and collaborative team. Our multicultural work environment gives you room to develop your skills and make a visible impact on Bluefors commercial growth.

Main responsibilities:

* Develop and execute Bluefors digital marketing strategy in line with business, marketing, and commercial objectives.

* Plan, manage, and optimize campaigns across owned, earned, and paid channels.

* Own and develop marketing automation, lead nurturing, lifecycle communications, and related processes.

* Act as Marketings key user and primary business stakeholder for Salesforce CRM and related commercial systems.

* Oversee website performance, social media channels, SEO, generative engine optimization, analytics, conversion, and user experience.

* Establish KPIs and reporting processes, turning performance data into actionable recommendations.

* Develop digital marketing systems, integrations, data flows, platform governance, and AI-enabled capabilities.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and manage relevant agencies, technology partners, and service providers.

What we expect from you

* Minimum 10 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong track record in areas such as marketing automation, campaign execution, and digital performance measurement, supported by relevant education

* Experience with CRM platforms, marketing technologies, campaign automation, lead management, and customer engagement processes.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and insights into actions that support commercial objectives.

* Strong understanding of digital channels, website management, SEO, performance marketing, and digital campaign execution.

* Ability to work effectively across teams and systems and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution and drive initiatives from concept to implementation.

* A curious and collaborative mindset combined with a strong focus on continuous improvement and optimizing performance, processes, and customer experiences.

* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

We also appreciate

* Experience from technology, engineering, scientific, industrial, or other highly technical B2B environments.

* Familiarity with Salesforce, CRM integrations, SEO, generative engine optimization, account-based marketing, and AI-enabled marketing tools.

* Experience managing agencies, technology partners, or external service providers.

Please apply as soon as possible, on October 18, 2026 at the latest, through our recruitment system at BLUEFORS.COM [http://BLUEFORS.COM]. We will review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

For more information, please contact our Director, Marketing & Communications, Ingela Waismaa, ingela.waismaa@bluefors.com [ingela.waismaa@bluefors.com]. Ingela can also be reached at +358 50 5306603 during the following times: Sept. 28, 08:00-09:00, Sept. 29, 17:00-18:00 and Oct. 13, 09:00-10:00.

title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance

title: Chief Specialist, Physical activity and functional capacity
description:
Are you passionate about advancing research and innovation that improves physical activity, functional capacity, and human performance across the lifespan? LAB University of Applied Sciences is seeking an internationally recognized researcher with expertise in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields to strengthen its Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group.

We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as physical activity promotion, prevention of functional decline, neurofunctional health, rehabilitation, digital health solutions, and data-driven assessment and monitoring of human function and performance.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to the scientific development of LAB's Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and strengthen its national and international profile. You will participate in high-quality research, build multidisciplinary collaborations, and support the development of impactful research, development, and innovation activities.

You will work closely with academic, healthcare, industry, and societal partners in Finland and internationally. You will be expected to actively acquire competitive research funding from Finnish, European, and international funding programmes, publish in leading peer-reviewed journals, and strengthen cooperation between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.

Key research tasks include:

- conducting and leading high-quality research in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields.
- acquiring competitive research funding from national and international funding instruments.
- leading and contributing to multidisciplinary research, development, and innovation projects.
- publishing scientific results in internationally recognized peer-reviewed journals.
- building and maintaining strategic partnerships with industry, healthcare organizations, public-sector actors, and academic institutions.
- strengthening research collaboration between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.
- Depending on the selected candidates experience and expertise, the role may also include leadership of the Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and responsibility for developing its strategic research agenda and scientific activities.

What we expect from you

You have a doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, sport and exercise sciences, physiotherapy, public health, biomedical sciences, human movement sciences, neuroscience, health technology, digital health, or another relevant discipline. Qualifications corresponding to the Finnish title of Docent (Adjunct Professor) are considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:

- a strong track record of internationally recognized research and scientific publications.
- demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding.
- experience in leading multidisciplinary research and development projects.
- experience in collaboration with industry, healthcare, public sector, and academic partners.
- strong communication, networking, and scientific leadership skills.
- The ability to lead and develop a multidisciplinary research team; previous research group leadership experience is considered an advantage.
- excellent English language skills (CEFR C1) and good working knowledge of Finnish (CEFR B2), or a willingness to develop Finnish language proficiency. Additional language skills are considered an asset.

What we offer

The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, and digital health research within a rapidly developing university research environment.

You will join an innovation-driven university of applied sciences with strong regional, national, and international networks. LAB provides access to a growing ecosystem of companies, research institutes, healthcare organizations, and public-sector partners that support collaboration and the development of new solutions. You will work in an increasingly international, highly skilled, and collaborative community that values openness, curiosity, and teamwork. You will also benefit from LAB's developing research infrastructure.

Your primary workplace can be either the Lahti or Lappeenranta campus. LAB follows a modern hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular collaboration on campus.

The position is permanent and full-time, starting on 1 November 2026 or as agreed. A six-month probationary period applies.

Employment conditions follow the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences (Sivistysala ry). The position falls under the working-time system for experts and support staff, with a regular working time of 36.25 hours per week.

The monthly salary ranges from approximately EUR 5,200 to EUR 6,100 depending on the successful candidates qualifications, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV through the recruitment system by 25 September 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). We will review applications on a rolling basis. Only applications submitted through the recruitment system will be considered.

For further information about the position, please contact RDI Director Kati Peltonen (kati.peltonen@lab.fi, +358 44 708 1041). She is available for enquiries on Friday, 18 September 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00 and on Tuesday, 22 September 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00 (Finnish time).

Read more about the LAB University of Applied Sciences [here](https://www.lab.fi/en/info/about-us).

The best of both worlds: studies and work. The LAB University of Applied Sciences is a higher education institution specialising in innovation, business and industry. It operates in Lahti and Lappeenranta, Finland, and also online. We offer education in five fields: health care and social services, technology, business, hospitality, and design, fine arts and visual communication. We focus on supporting responsible, regenerative growth through intangible value creation, multipurpose materials, and human well-being. We have 10 900 students and 650 teachers and RDI experts.

Technical support for using the recruitment system: recruitment@lab.fi

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Joroisiin
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Joroisen alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja 33-40h/vko, Loimaa
employer: Lounais-Suomen Lihastautiyhdistys ry, ruotsiksi Sydvästra Finlands Muskelhandikappförening rf
description:
Etsimme avustajarinkiimme vähintään yhtä (1) vakituista henkilökohtaista avustajaa avioparille.

Minä ja vaimoni sairastamme neurologisia sairauksia, jotka heikentävät toimintakykyämme etenevästi. Tarvitsemme avustajaa kaikissa päivittäisissä asioissa kuten syöminen, hygienia, liikkuminen ja asioilla käymisessä. Apuvälineitä ovat mm. Kattonosturi, manuaali pyörätuolit ja suihkutuoli. Työpäivät ovat pääsääntöisesti ma-su klo 8-21 välillä kahdessa vuorossa (8-15/ 14-21). Työvuorojen pituudesta voidaan neuvotella, ei ole kiveen kirjoitettuja. Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Avustajan työnkuvaan sisältyy:

\- lääkehoito

\- hygienian hoito myös intiimihygienia

\- hoitotyöt

\- ruuanlaitto ja syömisessä avustaminen

\- pyörätuolin työntämistä

\- vapaa-ajan riennoissa mukana olemista

\- kodinhoidolliset askareet

Opastan itse kaikissa työtehtävissä ja työhön perehdytetään.

Paikka sijaitsee Loimaan keskustassa. Palkkaus Heta-TESin mukaan, (palkkaluokka B2). Vakituinen paikka täytetään heti sopivan työntekijän löytyessä. Hoitotyön kokemuksesta on hyötyä.

Pääsääntöisesti uusiin työsuhteisiin kuuluu koeaika.

Lounais-Suomen Avustajakeskus/LSLY ry (avustajakeskus.fi) välittää henkilökohtaisia avustajia vammaisille työnantajille. Avustajan valinnasta päättää työnantaja itse.

title: Laboratory Test Engineer
description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field?*
- Do you have at least 3 years of experience working with power systems, electrical installations, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*
- Do you have experience with PSCAD or similar power system simulation software?*

title: HR-asiantuntija, Keliber-litiumhanke

title: Project Manager / AI Governance Lead

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle
description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Etsimme helpperiä avustamaan 16-vuotiasta asiakastamme koulupäivien ajan. Työaika arkisin klo 8-14.30.

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi?
Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii?
Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:
- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."
- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."
- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."

Helpperinä saat:
- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana
- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 12-16 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.
- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

title: KOKKI
description:
PALKATAAN KOKKI MONIPUOLISIIN TEHTÄVIIN, VAKITUISEEN JA KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN

Haemme ammattitaidostaan ylpeää kokkia yksityiseen perheyritykseen hotelli Gustavelundiin. Hotellimme sijaitsee Tuusulanjärven rannalla kauniissa puistomaisemissa, noin 15 min Helsinki-Vantaan lentokentältä ja puolen tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta.

Asiakaskuntamme koostuu kokouksissa, koulutuksissa ja erilaisissa yritystapahtumissa kokoontuvista ryhmistä, joille valmistamme kokoustarjoiluja, ryhmäillallisia sekä buffetruokailuja. Toteutamme laadukkaasti ja korkeatasoisesti monipuolisia ja vaihtuvia tuotteita: päivittäin tarjolla on hotelliaamiainen sekä lounas, iltaisin tarjoillaan bankettien lisäksi A la Cartea. Viikonloppuisin tarjoilemme brunsseja, olemme myös suosittu perhejuhlien pitopaikka. Terassillamme kesäkeittiössä valmistetaan grilliruokia ryhmille sekä salaatteja, pizzoja ja hampurilaisia walk-in asiakkaille. Hotellissamme järjestetään festivaalityyppisiä tapahtumia, kuten urheiluautotapaamisia, juhannusjuhla, bändi-iltoja ja varttuneemman väen disco-iltoja. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme mahdollisimman paljon itse tehtyä ruokaa, leivomme ja valmistamme annoksia tuoreista raaka-aineista.

Työkielenämme on suomi. Toivomme sinulta kausivaihteluiden vuoksi joustavuutta: käytössämme on MaRaTes tasausjärjestelmä. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, arkisin kello 6.00 - 20.30, viikonloppuisin alkaen kello 7.00 ja päättyen aina kulloisenkin tilaisuuden mukaan. Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Palkkauksen pohjana on MaRaTes sekä normaalit ilta-, sunnuntai- yms. lisät, Kokemuksen määrän ja laadun mukaan palkka on myös neuvoteltavissa.

Arvostamme asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta ja vieraanvaraisuutta sekä innostunutta ja innostavaa asennetta. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä ammattikoulutus ovat työssä onnistumisen edellytyksiä. Hakijoilta edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työpaikan, jatkuvan kehityksen ja uudistuksen alla olevat upeat puitteet, mukavat asiakkaat ja huippuluokan työkaverit. Kanssamme olet mukana kehittämässä toimintaa perheyrityksessä, jossa on helppo tuoda esiin omia näkemyksiä ja ideoita ja osallistua toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Työ alkaa heti.

title: Materiaalikoordinaattori
description:
Oletko sinä tiimimme seuraava huippuosaaja?

Haemme nyt sisustusmateriaalien materiaalikoordinaattoria liittymään Architectural Accommodation osastolle, joka toimii osana Hotel Design -yksikköä!

Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan maailman edistyksellisimpiä risteilyaluksia ja jätä kädenjälkesi laivanrakennuksen historiaan! Meyer Turku tarjoaa sinulle kannustavan työpaikan, jossa voit kehittyä ja tavoitella omannakoistasi tyouraa.

Hotel Design yksikkömme vastaa laivan kaikkien yleisten tilojen ulkoasusta ja suunnittelusta. Tähän kuuluvat hytit, hyttialueet, julkiset tilat (kuten teatterit, ravintolat ja miehistön julkiset tilat), hotellin palvelutekniset tilat ja arkkitehtoniset ulkoalueet. Yksikön vastuulla on toteuttaa asiakkaamme toimittaman arkkitehtimateriaalin design, sääntöjen, määräysten ja sovitun tason sallimissa puitteissa. Vastaamme myös eri järjestelmien reitityksen, sijainnin ja sijoittelun suunnittelusta sekä rungon suunnitteluun tarvittavien aukkojen koordinoinnista.

Architectural Accommodation osasto vastaa arkkitehtonisista systeemeistä ja sisustusalueiden perussuunnittelun koordinoimisesta. Lisäksi ryhmällä on ADA-, luovutusdokumentaatio-, IHM-, 3D- ja Sustainability spesialistit.

Osana Architectural Accommodation osastoa Material Coordination tiimimme vastaa matkustajille ja miehistölle näkyvien tilojen perussuunnittelusta ja tiettyjen materiaalien hankinnasta – sinun roolisi osana tiimiäsi on varmistaa, että tehtävään liittyvät hankintakokonaisuudet pysyvät hallinnassa moniprojektiympäristössä. Tiloja ovat esimerkiksi mm. hyttialueitten käytävät, sairaala ja ohjaamo.

Tehtävänkuvaus:

Tehtävääsi kuuluu materiaalikoordinaattorille nimetyn kokonaisuuden hallinta. Toimimme moniprojektiympäristössä eli osallistut tehtäväkokonaisuuden vastuullisena samanaikaisesti usean eri laivaprojektin vaiheisiin alusta loppuun. Toteutamme arkkitehtoniset ratkaisut laivanrakennuksen sääntöjen ja määräysten mukaan.

Tehtäväsi on koordinoida telakan rakentamien alueiden sisustusmateriaalien ja kalusteiden hankintoja osana tiimiä. Hankittavia materiaaleja ovat esimerkiksi katto- ja seinämateriaalit, kaiteet, verhot, WC-materiaalit. Valmistelet tekniset määritelmät ja rajaukset hankintoja varten, laadit kyselyaineiston liitteineen ja vastaat tarve- ja toimitusaikatauluista. Hankinnat tapahtuvat yhteistyössä ostajan kanssa.

Tehtävässä olet vastuussa budjetoinnista ja hankintakokonaisuuksiin liittyvien kulujen seurannasta ja hallinnasta. Ennakointi sekä kehitys- ja säästötoimenpiteet kuuluvat vastuullesi.

Tehtävään kuuluu vahva kommunikaatio eri toimijoiden kanssa. Osallistut neuvotteluihin kokonaisuuksien asiantuntijana. Materiaalin ekologisuuden ja soveltuvuuden selvittäminen käyttötarkoitukseen on vastuullasi ja hyväksytät ratkaisut ja toteutuksen tarvittaessa asiakkaallamme sekä tuotannossa.

Materiaaliosaamisen lisäksi tehtävä vaatii ymmärrystä teknisistä vaatimuksista ja ratkaisuista.

Työtehtäväsi ryhmässä muokkautuu ja kehittyy kokemuksesi mukaisesti. Nyt haemme henkilöä kasvamaan vastuulliseen tehtävään.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

Haemme tiimiimme aktiivista henkilöä, joka kykenee toimimaan tehokkaana ja positiivisena linkkinä niin oman ryhmän, kuin muiden osastojen, asiakkaan, arkkitehtien ja aluerakentajan välillä. Hallitset hyvin aikataulutuksen ja pystyt toimimaan samanaikaisesti usean eri tahon kanssa itsenäisesti.

Sinulla on kyky toimia hektisessä moniprojektiympäristössä, joka taas edellyttää kykyä suunnitella oma ajankäyttö projektien tarpeiden mukaan.

Taitoa ja näkemystä toimia asiakasrajapinnassa, joka on neuvotteluja ja päivittäistä kanssakäymistä telakan projektiosaston, perussuunnittelu- ja sisustusvarustelun osastojen kanssa. Työ sisältää myös materiaalitoimittajien kanssa neuvotteluja ja tiedonvaihtoa läpi projektien. Telakan organisaatiossa edustetaan systeemin parasta osaamista.

Eduksi katsotaan laivateollisuudessa yleisesti käytettyjen sisustusmateriaalien ja toimittajien tuntemus, kustannustieto sekä laivapuolen sääntöjen ja vaatimusten tuntemus.

Seuraavien ohjelmistojen hallintaa: Excel ja muut Office ohjelmat, SAP, Kronodoc /Wave, AutoCad / jonkin 3D ohjelma

Olet oma-aloitteinen, tartut reippaasti toimeen ja haluat olla mukana luomassa positiivista ja kannustavaa ilmapiiriä. Eduksi on, että sinulla on kokemusta projektikoordinoinnista ja tehtävään sopiva koulutus. Lisäksi tarvitset hyvää suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa.

Kokemus laivanrakennuksesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä kasvat laivanrakentajaksi kokeneiden osaajien opastuksessa.

Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin.

Miksi tulla meille töihin?

Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2024 liikevaihtomme oli 1,82 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 200.

Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä.

Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi.

title: Project Manager, Industrial projects
description:
Do you want to lead industrial investment projects that contribute to a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Managers to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will manage demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from project development and engineering through implementation, commissioning and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
At Sweco, you will work closely with clients, contractors, system and equipment suppliers, designers and Swecos multidisciplinary project organisation. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility for impactful projects while being supported by a strong network of experts.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and at least five years of experience in demanding industrial project delivery. This is not a discipline-specific project management role: you have experience leading broad, multidisciplinary project organisations and coordinating interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
You are able to manage the overall delivery of a complex industrial project, including scope, schedule, budget, risks, reporting and stakeholder collaboration. You can coordinate several technical disciplines and delivery partners, identify and resolve interface issues, and keep the project moving forward towards its objectives.
We expect you to have:
- At least five years of relevant experience in industrial project management or project delivery.
- Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary industrial projects during the implementation phase; experience with EPCM or similar industrial project delivery models is an advantage.
- Understanding of industrial project development, engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
- Strong stakeholder-management, communication and collaboration skills.
- Fluent written and spoken English; proficiency in Finnish and/or Swedish is an advantage.

What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

title: Service Engineer
description:
**Location: Vantaa, Finland**

At ADB SAFEGATE, we are shaping the future of airport performance. Our solutions help airports operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably — from aircraft approach to gate departure.

To strengthen our service team in Finland, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on **Service Engineer** to support our customers with advanced airport technology solutions.

**Your Mission**

In this role, you will be an important part of our technical team, ensuring that mission-critical airport systems are commissioned, maintained, and supported to the highest standards.

You will:

- Perform servicing, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and diagnostics of ADB SAFEGATE hardware and software systems, both on-site and remotely.

- Maintain and update technical documentation.

- Provide technical expertise and support to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders while independently taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Conduct on-site surveys and prepare technical reports.

- Represent ADB SAFEGATE professionally in all customer interactions.


**Your Profile**

We are looking for a practical, ambitious, and reliable professional who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership in an international environment.

**Required qualifications**

- A degree or professional qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Computer Science, IT, or a comparable technical field.

- Hands-on experience with electrical, automation, control, or industrial IT systems, including confidence in using technical tools, test equipment, and diagnostic software.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify faults across hardware, software, electrical, and control systems.

- Practical experience with low- or medium-voltage equipment and the ability to read electrical drawings and wiring diagrams.

- Professional working proficiency in Finnish and English, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and international colleagues.

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, including occasional short-notice assignments. Some commissioning and service activities may take place outside standard working hours.

- A valid Category B driving licence and willingness to travel independently to customer sites.

- Ability to manage assigned service and commissioning tasks independently while collaborating effectively with international engineering, project, and customer support teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to provide professional technical support, guidance, and updates.

- A proactive and responsible approach, with strong quality awareness, customer focus, and ownership of assigned tasks.


**Preferred qualifications**

- Previous experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, System Engineer, Service Technician, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.

- Experience with airport systems, airfield lighting, industrial infrastructure, or other safety- or operationally critical systems.

- Practical knowledge of PLC systems, switchgear, control equipment, and industrial automation.

- Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows and/or Linux operating systems.

- Working knowledge of SQL databases, including basic diagnostics, queries, and system support.

- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages used for diagnostics, configuration, automation, or system integration, such as Python, Bash, batch scripting, C#, or JavaScript.

- Experience with cloud-connected systems, remote monitoring solutions, networking, or remote support tools.

- A relevant Finnish electrical safety qualification. Candidates who are eligible and willing to obtain the required qualification may also be considered.

- Knowledge of other European languages.


**What We Offer**

At **ADB SAFEGATE**, you will join an innovative industry leader where your work directly contributes to safer and smarter airport operations worldwide.

**We offer:**

- A role in a global company setting benchmarks in airport safety, efficiency, and technology.

- A dynamic work environment with challenging and meaningful projects.

- International cooperation with experienced colleagues and customers.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and modern working models.

- The friendly atmosphere of a medium-sized company combined with the strength of a global organization.

- Opportunities for personal development, technical training, and professional growth.

- Opportunities to work on customer projects in Finland and across Europe.

- A varied, practical, and engaging role where no two days are the same.


**Ready to Help Airports Move Smarter?**

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on fieldwork, and want to be part of an international team delivering critical airport solutions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join ADB SAFEGATE and help shape the future of safe, efficient, and sustainable airport operations.**

title: Service Desk Technician
description:
**Service Desk Technician**

JOB PURPOSE

Serve as the first point of contact for Curium employees and partners worldwide, providing timely, high-quality technical assistance through the Global Service Desk. Log, diagnose, resolve and/or escalate incidents and service requests in line with agreed SLAs, while contributing to knowledge and continuous service improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

- Provide first-line support via Freshservice, phone, chat and email; ensure accurate ticket creation and lifecycle updates.

title: Composite worker

title: Wilderness Guide, full-time: private northern lights, snowshoe and ice fishing tours, Levi
description:
Juki Tours Oy is a tour operator based in Levi, Finnish Lapland. We build tailor-made Lapland holidays for the German-speaking, British and US markets. We are looking for a full-time tour guide for the winter season 2026-2027 to run our own private tours. Every tour is for one party only: no shared groups, no timetable-driven mass programme.

Your tasks

Evening northern lights tours: you drive a 7-seat minibus (Mercedes-Benz V-Class), read the weather and aurora forecasts and choose the location yourself. The tour lasts as long as the northern lights require, not by the clock.

Snowshoe tours in Pallas-Yllästunturi National Park and the surroundings of Levi

Ice fishing tours on nearby lakes

Every tour is private: one party at a time, 2-6 people. Guiding language English, German for German-speaking guests if you speak it.

Airport transfers between Kittilä Airport and accommodation, and transport of guests to activities and excursions in the Levi area

Equipment maintenance and tour preparation (snowshoes, ice fishing gear, snacks, vehicle)

Pick-up and return of guests at their accommodation in Levi

We require

Category B driving licence and confident driving in winter conditions, in the dark and on snowy forest roads

Fluent English: our guests come mainly from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the UK and the USA. German is a significant advantage

First aid training (EA1 or equivalent)

Wilderness skills: fire making, navigation, knowledge of equipment, working in the cold

Strong customer service attitude: on a private tour you are with the party the whole time

Initiative: you work alone on the tours and are responsible for the group

Entrepreneurial mindset: a small company where the work is varied

An advantage

Northern lights photography experience. We will train you for the role.

Previous guiding experience in Lapland

We offer

Fixed-term full-time employment 1.12.2026-17.3.2027

Salary: by invoicing 27 €/h, 30 €/h between 20:00 and 06:00. If employed, 2600 €/month plus a late-hour supplement of 1,38 €/h between 20:00 and 06:00 (Finnish collective agreement for the programme services sector)

Work clothing and equipment provided by the employer

Small team, direct contact with the owner, a real say in how the tours are run

title: Automation Engineer
description:
We at Rocsole are experts in electrical tomography and its application to industrial process monitoring. Our unique SeeBeyond technology helps customers detect and visualize liquids, solids, and interfaces in demanding industrial environments. Our LiquiDetect and SoliDetect products support safer, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our customers include major industrial and energy companies around the world.

We are looking for an **Automation Engineer** to join **#TeamROCSOLE**!

In this position, you will create and maintain electrical and automation documentation for Rocsole products, including wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and other related technical documentation. You will provide technical support throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to customer projects, commissioning activities, troubleshooting, and after-sales support together with Rocsoles Technical Support team.

You will work closely with our product development, production, and technical support professionals. Your responsibilities will include supporting electrical and functional testing, maintaining accurate product documentation, and ensuring that product modifications are properly reflected in drawings and technical materials.

You will also participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities. When required, you will support customers remotely or on-site. Occasional international travel is therefore part of the role.

The right candidate is a structured and detail-oriented professional with strong problem-solving skills. You are comfortable working independently, but you also collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. You take pride in producing accurate technical documentation and providing professional support in practical engineering situations.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

- Creating and maintaining wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and related technical documentation for Rocsole products

- Ensuring that electrical documentation meets Rocsoles quality standards, applicable requirements, and customer needs

- Updating drawings and documentation when product modifications and engineering changes are implemented

- Supporting production personnel with electrical and automation-related technical issues

- Supporting electrical and functional testing of products before shipment

- Participating in verification and validation activities for new products and product modifications

- Supporting commissioning and startup activities together with Rocsoles Technical Support Specialist

- Participating in factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT)

- Providing remote and on-site technical support when required


**We expect you to have:**

- A bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or another relevant technical field

- Relevant work experience in electrical schematic and wiring diagram design

- Experience with SolidWorks Electrical, DraftSight, or equivalent electrical design tools

- Basic knowledge of PLCs and automation systems

- Strong attention to detail and a structured, systematic approach to your work

- Good problem-solving, communication, and customer service skills

- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

- Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

- Willingness to travel internationally on occasion


Equivalent competence acquired through relevant work experience may also be considered.

**The following will be considered an advantage:**

- Experience in designing and documenting 230 VAC industrial electrical systems

- A valid SFS 6002 Electrical Safety Training certificate

- Knowledge of the SFS 6000 electrical installation standards

- Experience with industrial instrumentation and sensors

- Experience with industrial communication networks

- Understanding of Ex, ATEX, or IECEx requirements


Our company embraces personal and professional growth. If you are looking for practical engineering challenges and an opportunity to develop your expertise in industrial automation, instrumentation, and sensor technology, this could be the right place for you.

Our office is located in Kuopio, Finland, where your workstation and colleagues are waiting for you. The position is full-time and permanent. Occasional international travel is required.

**We shape the future of industrial process monitoring. Come join us! More info at: https://rocsole.co/AutEng**

title: Scientist / Senior Scientist in Mass Spectrometry-based Proteome Research
description:
About Us

The Helsinki Proteomics Center (HPC) is a state-of-the-art technology platform operating across two life-science campuses at the University of Helsinki. Dedicated to advancing proteomics research, we provide cutting-edge services and collaborate with researchers to explore protein functions, interactions, and dynamics. This position is based at the Viikki Proteomics Unit, which is part of the Helsinki Proteomics Center.

Your Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Senior Scientist to join the Viikki Proteomics Unit. This is primarily a hands-on core-facility position: the appointee will help deliver reliable proteomics services, support facility users, maintain robust daily operations, and develop methods that can be implemented across the HPC service portfolio. The role is therefore best suited to a collaborative scientist who is motivated by enabling the research of others as well as advancing proteomics technology.

Key Responsibilities

Research and Development
* Investigate and evaluate new sample preparation protocols for bottom-up proteomics, including protein digestion, peptide clean-up, enrichment of post-translationally modified peptides, and handling sub-nanogram protein quantities.
* Optimize protocols for sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility, and evaluate new MS data-acquisition and analysis workflows for implementation as new or improved HPC services.


Operational Support
* Perform day-to-day technical operation of the high-resolution LC-MS/MS systems.
* Prepare customer and internal samples using validated facility protocols.
* Participate in routine maintenance of existing equipment, quality-control checks, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate records of instrument usage, downtime, maintenance, and experimental procedures.


Collaboration and Communication
* Work closely with HPC colleagues to maintain an efficient, safe, and well-organized core-facility laboratory, and coordinate priorities to deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.
* Advise facility users on experimental design, sample requirements, available technologies, instrument capabilities and limitations, and realistic expected outcomes.
* Prepare clear reports, discuss results and appropriate next steps with users, and provide evidence-based recommendations to HPC leadership on new platforms, methods, and technologies.


Administrative Duties
* Oversee inventory and coordinate procurement to ensure uninterrupted operation of the Viikki Proteomics Unit.
* Work with service contract providers to restore operations of the LC-MS/MS system promptly after system downtime.


Qualifications

Educational Background
* Master's degree required; Ph.D. preferred in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or a related life science discipline.

Experience
* 2+ years of research experience with proteomic or related technologies.
* Strong background in protein chemistry is required.
* Experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics is highly preferred.

Technical Skills
* Proficiency in using both vendor-specific and publicly available software tools for MS data analysis.
* Detail-oriented both at the lab bench and with record-keeping.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


Soft Skills
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, service-oriented team environment.
* Willingness to learn, standardize, document, and routinely apply a range of sample preparation protocols.
* Ability to provide demonstrations and training to facility users with varying levels of proteomics experience.
* Motivation to expand data-analysis expertise and contribute to user support and reporting.


What We Offer
* The salary is based on the Finnish university salary system, depending on qualifications and experience.
* The University of Helsinki provides occupational health services, staff well-being resources, access to sports facilities, and extensive opportunities for professional development.
* You will join a world-class research community, work with cutting-edge technologies, and collaborate with leading experts in the field.


Join Us
Employment is expected to start on November-December, 2026, or as agreed. The position is initially offered for two years with the possibility of extension. A 6-month trial period will be applied. The formal title of the position will be determined according to the appointee's qualifications and experience: Research Coordinator/Postdoctoral Researcher / Specialist (for an appointee with a MSc).

How to Apply
Applications should be submitted through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System at [application link] by clicking the "Apply now" button.
For the relevant application enclosers and further information, please see our website.
Application deadline: September 30, 2026

title: Kotisiivooja Virroille
description:

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

title: Car Driver, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Car Drivers for the Christmas season 2026 to Lapland Safaris offices in Levi and Saariselkä.**

Please note that we are currently accepting applications **only from candidates who already have the right to work in Finland.** Unfortunately, due to the processing times for work permits and the schedule of our recruitment, we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require a new work permit to work in Finland. **This includes applicants from the UK, Australia, and other non-EU countries who do not already hold a valid right to work in Finland.**

The duties of a Lapland Safaris driver mainly consist of transporting, loading, and collecting equipment bags containing our guests winter clothing from local hotels and Lapland Safaris locations. In addition, your tasks will include supporting safari operations, such as sorting, maintaining, and drying equipment. Due to long distances, you may also occasionally transport staff between different locations, or between the workplace and staff accommodation.

The vehicles you drive will vary from passenger cars to vans, 9seat minibuses, and even vans equipped with a tail lift that can be driven with a category B driving license. Our working language is English, so good English skills is considered an advantage.

In addition to a valid driving license, we expect flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, as your workdays may sometimes be long. You are the person we are looking for if you are hardworking, proactive, well organized, and reliable.

The work is physically demanding and partly carried out in challenging weather conditions, including Laplands winds and snowstorms. You will work as part of a larger equipment maintenance team, and your contribution is highly important to the operation of Lapland Safaris.

**We offer you:**

- A great team to work with

- The beautiful landscapes of Lapland

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits from Lapland Hotels & Safaris, including discounts on equipment rental, restaurants, and lift tickets at Lapland Ski Resorts.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. The work starts in mid-to-late November and is expected to last until the last week of December.

. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 11,30 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish public holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews and selections will be conducted already during the application period, so please apply soon! Positions will be filled as suitable candidates are found.

**More information:** info@laplandstaff.fi
