title: Postdoc Researcher (f/m/d) in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals (Biologe/Biologin)
description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 November 2026:

Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)

in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals** (m/f/d)**

(Full time / part time** **options available)

﻿

Location: Frankfurt am Main
Employment scope: Full-time; part time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.

Your tasks

- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses
- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches
- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling
- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses
- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party funding

Your profile

- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field
- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.
- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage
- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R
- Very good written and oral communication skills in English
- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigenetics

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application as a single PDF by 5 October 2026, including:

- CV
- Letter of motivation
- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials
- Two relevant publications
- Contact details of two potential references

Please compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.de

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/

Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

title: FP&A Controller (m/f/d) (Controller/in)
description:
Location: Munich | Full-time | Permanent

About us

At Life Couriers, we understand how important the critical moments in life are.

As the global leader in radiopharmaceutical and stem cell logistics, we have leveraged our experience with some of the world’s most time-critical shipments to expand our services to biopharmaceuticals, cell and gene therapies, laboratory specimens, clinical trials, organ transplants, medical devices, and more.

Because we know that a missed delivery can mean the loss of a life. That is why we have built our company culture around one clear priority: patient outcomes. Our employees are committed to improving, enriching, and saving lives through the power of logistics.

To strengthen our Controlling team, we are looking for a FP&A Controller (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible.

Your Responsibilities

- Drive monthly management reporting, business reviews and performance analyses for assigned business units
- Partner with business unit heads as a finance sparring partner, providing financial insights, challenging assumptions and supporting operational and strategic decision-making
- Support budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning processes, including the development and maintenance of financial models
- Analyze business performance and variances, identify key business drivers and translate financial data into actionable recommendations
- Support strategic finance initiatives, including commercial improvement, operational optimization, investment decisions and growth opportunities
- Develop and standardize reporting structures, KPIs and planning processes
- Ensure data quality through validation, reconciliation and continuous improvement of reporting processes
- Build and improve scalable FP&A and controlling processes to support the company’s next stage of growth

Your Profile

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, business administration, economics, business analytics or a comparable field
- First professional experience in FP&A, controlling, finance, audit, transaction services, consulting or business intelligence
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear and concise business insights
- Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other BI tools highly advantageous; knowledge of LucaNet or Business Central a plus
- Proactive, structured and independent working style with a hands-on mentality, strong ownership and attention to details
- Confident communication and strong business partnering skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with finance teams, business unit leaders and management in an international environment
- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

What We Offer

- A high-impact FP&A role with early responsibility for business unit performance and direct exposure to senior management
- The opportunity to shape finance structures, reporting, and decision-making in a growing and dynamic environment
- The opportunity to leverage and further develop your expertise across business partnering, analytics, strategic finance, transformation topics, and the value creation agenda of a private equity portfolio company
- A collaborative, international team with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and the opportunity to make a visible contribution
- Flexible working model including home office options and flexible working hours (flextime)
- 30 days of annual leave
- Access to employee benefits such as Wellpass or Sodexo
- A purpose-driven company environment, contributing to meaningful healthcare logistics at Life Couriers
- A modern, supportive workplace where your ideas and impact truly matter

Application

Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to receiving your application!

Please send your complete application (CV, cover letter, references), including your salary expectations and earliest possible start date, to: recruiting@lifecouriers.com (https://mailto:recruiting@lifecouriers.com)

We welcome applications from all backgrounds, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

title: Director of Data Center Operations (Germany m/f/d) (IT-Manager/in)
description:
Candidate will be responsible for:

- Providing leadership, direction and strategy across our German territory.
- Building and leading a new DCO organization in Germany.
- Working with geographically distributed teams and contributing to the success of his/her organization and other related teams.
- Coaching and mentoring managers and individual contributors across the organization.
- Growing the team by recruiting and retaining top talent.
- Delivering large-scale projects on-time with high quality.
- Collaborating and working effectively with various teams across the organization at both a technical level and a business level.
- Ensuring all sites are delivered to a standardized, high-quality bar, and this quality is sustained, day on day, week on week, year on year.
- Holding others to account as needed to ensure we meet our quality & delivery goals.
- Defining and contributing to global objectives to move the organization forwards.

As a Director of German Data Centre Operations, you will lead the region and be responsible for the overall availability of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be able to dive deep into any part of the stack and higher-level system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. You should have a demonstrated track record working in the industry, already having worked at hyperscale in previous positions. You should be fully versed in Data Centre build, live operations management, change control and be familiar with LEAN and 5S.

Detailed Description and Job Requirements

Working with world-class global teams to implement and support cutting-edge Oracle technology in Cloud Data Centres requires an experienced manager with a proven ability to lead from the front who can thrive in a complex matrix environment.

To maximize the quality of delivery and reliability of our sites you will:

- Work across multiple LOB effectively, negotiating and bringing together stakeholders & teams to ensure success for Oracle.
- Negotiating and working with local vendors to deliver a strategy to drive performance and meet quality expectations. This encompasses LV cabling vendors through to Colocation partners.
- Work closely with Human Resources within the regions to ensure the best possible relationship and care for your Oracle employees.
- Focus and prioritize appropriately on what is most important to Oracle at any given time as priorities can shift quickly.
- Drive scalability practices to ensure efficiencies across your organization and space.

Project work will also be a crucial part of the engagement, you will also:

- Lead the implementation of multi-functional projects and/or systems.
- Manage scope, expectations, implementation approach, deliverables and acceptance testing criteria, whilst appropriately managing risk.
- Driving the delivery of improvements. Interacting across functional areas to ensure objectives are met.
- Driving the development of short, medium, and long-term plans and regularly interacting across functional areas with executives to achieve strategic objectives.
- Demonstrate a track record of influencing thinking and gaining acceptance of others in sensitive situations.
- Be proactive at all times, resolving issues before they become critical.
- Work independently without escalation or supervision.
- Manage upwards effectively to VP level, with succinct, clear communication, and a solution-first approach.
- Manage individual contributors where you do not have direct authority over them.
- Resolve conflicts without escalation, by negotiation, understanding and mediating as necessary.
- Lead by example at all times.
- Be fully versed in managing risk (both project delivery and infrastructure management).
- Be able to devise plans, and strategies, bringing others on the journey with you.
- Be continuously learning about new technology advantages related to Data Centres (e.g. power density, cooling, cabling, critical load management) a SME in at least two areas.

You should be able to:

Candidate can expect:

- A stable environment with low turnover and great opportunities to grow.
- A merit-based organization.
- An opportunity to contribute to a well-recognized, revenue-producing Oracle product that has thousands of customers as well as be involved in cutting-edge technology
- Challenging and diverse projects.
- Competitive salary and benefits.

What you need to know to be successful in this role:

- 10+ years of proven Data Centre leadership and management at hyperscale levels.
- Detailed understanding of LEAN & Six Sigma
- Demonstrated use of AI to create business value
- A deep understanding of managing resources across global teams and the local laws that can affect this.
- In-depth knowledge of the Data Center ecosystem. (cooling, electrical, networking, structured cabling, etc.)
- 5 years or more of Vendor relationship management and negotiations.
- Deep experience with distributed, highly scalable, multi-node environments.
- Written and Spoken fluency in English & German
- Strong multi-culture awareness.
- Strong HR relationship and negotiating skills at a business level to achieve objectives.
- Degree educated in a related scientific or engineering discipline.

title: Sales Manager (all genders) (Account-Manager/in)
employer: INFORM Institut für OR und Management GmbH
description:
Du möchtest Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, ihren Personaleinsatz smarter, effizienter und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten? Als Sales Manager im Bereich Workforce Management gewinnst du neue Kunden und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei verkaufst du keine Standardlösung, sondern begeisterst Entscheider für innovative Software, die komplexe Prozesse nachhaltig verbessert. Mit deinem Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und deiner Leidenschaft für New Business gestaltest du unseren Wachstumskurs aktiv mit. Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

Was du bei uns bewegen kannst:

- Du identifizierst und priorisierst geeignete Zielkunden und Marktpotenziale, generierst eigenständig Leads und betreibst aktiv Outbound Sales – insbesondere über Cold Calls, E-Mail und Social Selling – und baust eine qualifizierte New-Business-Pipeline auf.
- Du führst Erst- und Discovery Calls durch, analysierst Kundenanforderungen und identifizierst konkrete Pain Points im Bereich Personaleinsatzplanung und Workforce Management. Auf dieser Basis führst du Consultative-Selling-Prozesse auf Augenhöhe mit Fachbereichen und Entscheidern.
- Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Pre-Sales passende Business Cases und präsentierst unsere SaaS-Lösung überzeugend gegenüber Fach- und Führungskräften bis hin zum C-Level.
- Du steuerst komplexe Sales-Prozesse mit mehreren Stakeholdern und Entscheidern, führst Verhandlungen und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zum Vertragsabschluss – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Pre-Sales, Legal und IT-Consulting.
- Du dokumentierst und pflegst deine Sales-Aktivitäten, verantwortest ein konsequentes Pipeline-Management und baust strategisch nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Gleichzeitig beobachtest du Markt und Wettbewerb und identifizierst neue Vertriebspotenziale.

Was du dafür mitbringst:

Must-Haves:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung sowie Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, insbesondere im New Business.
- Erfahrung in Outbound Sales, Cold Calling, im Verkauf erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte und in der eigenständigen Steuerung des gesamten Sales Cycles.
- Ausgeprägte Hunter-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative und Abschlussorientierung sowie starke Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten, Durchhaltevermögen und Teamgeist.
- Begeisterung für Technologie, Digitalisierung und erklärungsbedürftige Software, Bereitschaft zur Weiterentwicklung und schnellen Einarbeitung sowie zu 1–3 Tagen Reisetätigkeit pro Woche.

Nice-to-Haves:

- Erfahrung im SaaS-/Software-Vertrieb und/oder in Retail, Logistik, Produktion oder Dienstleistung.
- Kenntnisse in Workforce Management, Personaleinsatzplanung oder HR-Tech.
- Erfahrung im C-Level-Sales, mit komplexen Buying Centern und im Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen.
- Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, strukturiertem Pipeline-Management sowie der Erstellung und Präsentation von Business Cases.
- Kenntnisse etablierter Sales-Methoden wie MEDDPICC, Challenger oder Solution Selling.

Wie wir deine Arbeit wertschätzen:

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten, Workation, Sabbatical
- Kinderbetreuungszuschuss und weitere familienfreundliche Angebote
- Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und weitere Gesundheits-/Sportangebote z. B. Bike-Leasing
- Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektiven mit vielfältigen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Vielfältiges, gesundes und bezuschusstes Mittagessen in unserer Kantine
- Großes INFORM-Sommerfest, Betriebs- und Teamausflüge sowie eine Weihnachtsfeier

title: RF Lab Technician (f/m/d) (Elektroniker/in - Geräte und Systeme)
description:
For our client, a leading global technology company, we are looking for a RF Lab Technician (f/m/d) in Munich.

Responsibilities:

- Work closely with test engineers, team leads, and international colleagues to support day-to-day lab operations.
- Support and maintain test setup infrastructure for test campaigns and regression testing.
- Perform and document ESD measurements in the laboratory using dedicated ESD test equipment and initiate corrective actions where compliance gaps are identified.
- Prepare boards and hardware for testing and ensure test setups are ready for use.
- Manage the secure storage and distribution of hardware, including maintaining accurate assignment records for test engineers.
- Carry out mechanical modifications and installations of laboratory racks and test systems.
- Install measurement equipment, switches, passive filters, and associated DC, data, and RF cabling.
- Plan, install, and arrange new or enhanced regression test setups in the laboratory.
- Perform functional validation, troubleshooting, and calibration of test setups.
- Coordinate the calibration, repair, and upgrade of laboratory equipment, including hardware and firmware updates.
- Manage annual calibration activities, including preparing devices for on-site calibration or shipment to external service providers.
- Coordinate with third-party vendors to ensure smooth and timely calibration services, including capacity planning, scheduling, and quality follow-up.
- Ensure the appropriate DGUV testing of measurement equipment returning to the lab after shipment, while taking relevant EHS requirements into account.
- Coordinate replacement of essential and business-critical equipment during repair or calibration periods.
- Maintain laboratory inventory and ensure availability and quality of required materials.
- Manage lab consumables, including ordering and logistics planning.
- Verify the RF performance of relevant materials, such as dismantled RF coaxial cables, using a network analyzer.
- Support the restructuring and organization of component and hardware storage within the laboratory.
- Support the scrapping and disposal process for end-of-life devices.
- Maintain and regularly update laboratory databases and inventory records.
- Support measurement-device inventory control and reconciliation with SAP documentation for fiscal audits.
- Ensure high data quality for CAPEX equipment by maintaining information such as device location, calibration status, hardware/software options, and business-criticality indicators.

Skills:

- Completed technical education or vocational training in electronics, electrical engineering, communications engineering, or a comparable field.
- Practical experience working with electronic equipment and laboratory/test environments.
- Experience with test setups, measurement equipment, cabling, and hardware installation.
- Basic knowledge of RF technology and RF measurement equipment is an advantage.
- Experience with ESD measurements and laboratory ESD requirements is a plus.
- Good mechanical skills and a hands-on approach to installing and modifying test infrastructure.
- Experience coordinating equipment calibration, repairs, or external service providers is beneficial.
- Familiarity with inventory management, databases, and/or SAP is an advantage.
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with engineers and international teams.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when maintaining technical documentation and inventory data.
- German and English fluent.
- A proactive, solution-oriented, and hands-on working style.

For this role the working contract is done through our agency and is fixed on 1 year with option to be extended/take over.

title: Project Manager (f/m/d) Supplier Relationship & Resilience (Orion) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Project Manager (f/md) for Supplier Relationship Management & Supply Chain Resilience, you will work closely with the management team of GS D Procurement and the Gas Services Project Orion. Your role is essential to drive objectives of the ORION project to de-risk the GS D supply chain. In this role you report to the Head of Commodity Management and will work closely with the head of GS D procurement and the CPOs of the product lines, as well as the project organization in Gas Services. The tasks range from monitoring, improvement and developing the supplier relationship management and risk-mitigation in the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Establish, maintain, and actively manage supplier relationship management activities
* Analyze supply chain de-risking activities across GS D, benchmark and exchange with Orion project team members on Gas Services level, drive improvements and process harmonization
* Drive cost-saving initiatives and risk-mitigation actions together with commodity managers, project management, finance, engineering, and supply chain teams
* Increase data-driven decision making, leveraging integrated supply chain tools and support of AI
* Prepare transparent project progress tracking, identifying risks and taking mitigation action with SQ, Procurement, Engineering in GS D

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, combined with project management skills, and understanding of supply chain topics across the value chain from Sales, to Engineering and to Procurement.
* Longstanding professional experience in managing complex projects, financial analysis, procurement, or a comparable environment, typically gained over 5+ years.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, strategic-thinking, influencing, and process-improvement skills across procurement, finance, project management, and supply chain interfaces.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders and track record of realizing project targets on time & on budget.
* Fluent in English and German is an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

description:
Raus aus dem Takt, rein in die Wirkung.

Facharzt (m/w/d) für Kardiologie

Über Epidaurus

EPIDAURUS ist eine etablierte Privatpraxis im Herzen Dresdens – mit Kardiologie als Schwerpunkt und einem einzigartigen, interdisziplinären Setup. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2008 erbringen wir evidenzbasierte medizinische Leistungen auf hohem Niveau – mit dem Anspruch, nicht nur Symptome zu behandeln, sondern Gesundheit ganzheitlich zu fördern und langfristig zu erhalten.

Was uns besonders macht, ist unser Praxisverständnis: Privat – und vor allem frei. Wir verbinden moderne Kardiologie mit Prävention, Leistungsmedizin und interdisziplinärem Denken. Als privatärztliche Praxis schaffen wir dafür den nötigen Raum: für sorgfältige Diagnostik, individuelle Therapieentscheidungen und ärztlichen Gestaltungsspielraum.

Die Stelle ist mit 30 bis 40 Wochenstunden vorgesehen.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie übernehmen die selbstständige fachärztliche Betreuung unserer kardiologischen Patienten auf hohem medizinischem Niveau.
• Sie entwickeln individuelle, ganzheitliche Behandlungspläne – in enger Abstimmung mit Ihren Kollegen aus anderen Fachrichtungen.
• Sie bauen nachhaltige Arzt-Patienten-Beziehungen auf, sehen den Fortschritt und begleiten Ihre Patienten– durch Zeit, Aufmerksamkeit und persönliche Beratung.
• Sie beteiligen sich aktiv an Fort- und Weiterbildungen – fachlich wie persönlich.
• Sie wirken an der inhaltlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Praxis mit.

Was Sie bei uns erwartet

• Eine moderne Privatpraxis mit breitem diagnostischem und therapeutischem Spektrum.
• Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten – nicht am Wochenende, nicht an Feiertagen.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter / Payroll Specialist (m/w/d) ungarisch (Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter/in)
description:
Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter / Payroll Specialist (m/w/d)

Die europakraft GmbH ist eine Vermarktungsplattform für erstklassige Metallfachkräfte, freiberufliche Industriedienstleister (Freelancer) sowie Leiharbeitnehmer.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter / Payroll Specialist (m/w/d) für unsere Standorte Metzingen oder Budapest.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung der monatlichen Entgeltabrechnung unter Berücksichtigung gesetzlicher und betrieblicher Vorgaben
- Kompetenter Ansprechpartner für Krankenkassen, Sozialversicherungsträger und Behörden
- Aufbereitung, Prüfung und Abstimmung der Abrechnungsdaten sowie Durchführung der Gehaltsbuchungen und Mitwirkung bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen
- Pflege der Stamm-, Zeit- und Bewegungsdaten im Abrechnungssystem zvoove (ehemals Landwehr)

Ihr Profil

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entgeltabrechnung
- Gute Kenntnisse im Arbeits-, Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
- Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse

title: Technischer Vertriebsaußendienst (m/w/d) – Marktentwicklung Ungarn (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
description:

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: U114 Boltvezető-helyettes (Verkaufsfahrer/in)
description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

description:
Nettó Höfn í Hornafirði leitar að starfsfólki í tvö störf við áfyllingu kvöld/nætur. Um er að ræða starf þar sem vinnutími er að jafnaði frá kl. 20:00–04:00, sex daga vikunnar.
Starfið felst fyrst og fremst í áfyllingu og frágangi á vörum að kvöldi og nóttu. Stærstur hluti vinnutímans er eftir lokun verslunar en hluti vaktar getur verið á opnunartíma.

Starfið hentar vel einstaklingi sem er sjálfstæður, skipulagður og vinnur rösklega. Mikilvægt er að geta unnið eftir skipulagi vinnustaðar, forgangsraðað verkefnum og sýnt frumkvæði.

2.    Framstilling og tiltekt í verslun
3.    Móttaka og frágangur vöru eftir þörfum
4.    Aðstoð við viðskiptavini á opnunartíma
5.    Önnur tilfallandi verkefni í verslun
Hæfniskröfur:
1.    Sjálfstæði og ábyrgð í starfi
2.    Skipulögð og vönduð vinnubrögð

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. The company has a strong reputation of providing customers with a complete range of solutions including; aircraft maintenance modifications, technical, engineering and design services, logistics and material solutions and international training and consultancy. This reputation is built on a proud history and tradition of superior craftsmanship, technical expertise and continuous training, which is supported by our flexible, open and partnership-based customer relationships. The company provides a range of aviation solutions including; Part 145 Aircraft Maintenance, CAMO & Technical Services, Part 21 Design Services and the EASA Part 147 Atlantic Aviation Institute which provides aviation training to airlines, MRO’s and companies around the world. Aircraft Sheet Metal Worker required to join the Structures Team in AAG. In this role you will be required to join the existing team in a busy Production environment. You will be expected to perform all types of repairs, assessments and modifications to Aircraft Structures and components. General Responsibility Accountable for the Safe, On-Time delivery of all Structural repairs. Repair, rework, install and fabricate the complex aircraft structural assemblies, both internal and external. Remove and disassemble defective parts of the aircraft Adhere to company procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality standards at all times, reporting any discrepancies to respective Manager/Team Leader, generating SMS reports as necessary Carry out all repairs and tasks using the relevant approved Repair Manuals, Drawings/Technical Instructions as provided by the OEM Maintain a safe, organized and clean work environment according to in house 5S principles, including proper usage of tooling Ensures relevant repair documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner Working collaboratively with your Crew Leader, inspector and the Production team. Integration of our values and pillars as a constant way of operating including compliance with the organisational policies and procedures detailed in the Atlantic Aviation Group MOE and Supporting manuals. Candidate Requirements Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Aircraft Structures repair/modification. Heavy maintenance experience is an advantage but not essential. Must be proficient in the use of Aircraft manuals, Boeing Engine Atlantic Aviation Group is an equal opportunities employer. The people of Atlantic Aviation Group are the foundation of its success, and we believe that employing a diverse workforce is key to this success.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities: Operational Management: Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management: Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting: Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You: Essential Experience & Skills: Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

title: Our Generation Youth Worker - Donegal
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Youth Work Ireland is seeking a passionate and motivated Our Generation Youth Worker to join the Our Generation Project in County Donegal. This full-time hybrid role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the mental health, wellbeing, and personal development of young people through innovative youth work programmes. As an Our Generation Youth Worker, you will recruit and engage young people, build strong relationships with schools, youth clubs, and community organisations, and deliver structured programmes including Mind Matters, CHOICE, Stand UPP, and Rise Up. These programmes focus on emotional resilience, leadership, healthy relationships, wellbeing, and peace-building across communities. In this role, you will deliver evidence based youth programmes that promote mental health, emotional resilience, leadership, and wellbeing for young people. You will work across schools, youth clubs, and community organizations throughout County Donegal, building strong partnerships and creating engaging opportunities that empower young people and support positive outcomes. You will also collaborate with colleagues and partner organizativos to deliver high-quality programmes that strengthen communities and encourage cross-community and cross-border engagement. Key Requirements * Level 7 qualification (or higher) in Youth & Community Work, Social Work, Social Care, or a related Social Science discipline. * Experience delivering structured programmes or workshops with young people. * Excellent communication, organizational, and teamwork skills. * Ability to engage young people in a variety of educational and community settings. * Full, clean driving license and access to a car (essential). * Willingness to travel regularly throughout County Donegal. This is a 35-hour per week hybrid position, a fixed-term contract from October 2026 to September 2027, with a starting salary of €41,500.49. If you are committed to empowering young people and creating positive change in your community, we would love to hear from you.

CSSD and Decontamination The role includes supporting the safe reprocessing and management of reusable surgical instruments and equipment. Responsibilities include: Receive, clean and prepare reusable surgical instruments and equipment for reprocessing. Carry out the required stages of the decontamination cycle, including cleaning, washer-disinfection, drying, inspection, assembly, packaging and sterilisation.

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

description:

Italia

Full time

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

* Formazione tecnica completata (ad es. meccatronico, elettrotecnico) o qualifica equivalente

* Esperienza nel settore degli impianti a biogas, degli impianti energetici o delle messe in servizio industriali - almeno 3 anni

* Conoscenze di tecnologia di controllo, regolazione e misurazione

* Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente all'estero

* Stile di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni

* Capacità di lavorare in team, impegno e orientamento al cliente

* Italiano come lingua madre o fluente, buona padronanza del tedesco o dell'inglese

Our offer

In qualità di datore di lavoro attraente, offriamo a persone di talento e motivate incarichi stimolanti e variegati in un contesto internazionale, con opportunità di crescita a lungo termine. In quanto azienda familiare di successo, attribuiamo grande importanza a un clima di rispetto reciproco e a una collaborazione orientata al lavoro di squadra. Inoltre, ci impegniamo attivamente a favore della sostenibilità e della tutela dell'ambiente, implementando processi che preservano le risorse e lavorando costantemente alla riduzione della nostra impronta ecologica.

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. description:

Industrial Design Engineer

Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?
