title: Førsteamanuensis i helse, bevegelse og funksjon
description:
Ved Høgskulen på Vestlandet (HVL) er det ledig 100 % fast stilling som førsteamanuensis i helse, bevegelse og funksjon ved Fakultet for helse-og sosialvitskap – campus Bergen

Ved Høgskulen på Vestlandet (HVL) er det ledig 100 % fast stilling som førsteamanuensis ved Fakultet for helse- og sosialvitskap, Institutt for helse og funksjon. Stillingen er en instituttsdekkende fag- og utviklingsstilling med et særlig ansvar for å styrke sammenhengen, kvaliteten og den faglige retningen på tvers av instituttets utdanninger og seksjoner. Arbeidsområdet omfatter både helsefaglige profesjonsutdanninger og samarbeidet med idretts-, folkehelsefagene. Slik sett har stillingen en tydelig rolle som faglig brobygger mellom fagmiljøer som deler et felles kunnskapsgrunnlag, men som i dag er organisert i ulike fakultære strukturer. 

Instituttet befinner seg i en periode med betydelig utdanningsutvikling. Utdanningene beveger seg i retning av mer helhetlige, relasjonelle og sammenhengende læringslandskap, der koblingen mellom basisfag, profesjonsfag, praksisstudier og tjenestefeltet får stadig større betydning. Dette krever en fagperson som kan bidra til å videreutvikle instituttets utdanningsportefølje, og som har innsikt i hvordan læringsforløp kan skapes, styrkes og koordineres på tvers av programmer og fagmiljøer. 

Stillingen passer derfor for en fagperson med erfaring fra programutvikling, utdanningsledelse og kvalitetsarbeid, og som har en helhetlig forståelse av hvordan utdanningsstrukturer kan utvikles. Kompetanse i humanfysiologi – grunnleggende og anvendt – er sentral, da dette fagområdet binder sammen flere.


Ansvars- og arbeidsområde:
  • Bidra aktivt i videreutvikling av studieprogrammer, emner og tverrprogrammatisk struktur. 
  • Styrke sammenhengen mellom basisfag, profesjonsfag og praksis.
  • Bidra til pedagogisk utviklingsarbeid, vurderingsformer og læringsdesign på tvers av programmer.
  • Fremme samarbeid mellom fysioterapi, idrett, helsefremming og folkehelse. 
  • Faglig ansvar, undervisning og veiledning innen humanfysiologi og beslektede fagområder. 
  • Delta i utvikling av nye lærings- og praksismodeller i samarbeid med tjenestefeltet. 
  • Utvikle og lede forskningsbaserte lærings- og utviklingsprosesser i skjæringspunktet mellom utdanning, praksis og tjenestefelt. 
  • Initiere og/eller bidra i forsknings- og utviklingsarbeid relevant for helse- og bevegelsesfag. 
  • Bistå programledere og instituttleder med strategisk utdanningsutvikling og kvalitetsforbedring. 
  • Bidra til faglig institusjonsbygging, kollegial utvikling og utdanningsledelse (emneansvar, utviklingsprosjekter, strategiske utvalg).

Kvalifikasjoner:

Kriterier for ansettelse i stilling som førsteamanuensis fremgår av Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven 

Formell utdanning og kompetanse:

  • Relevant helsefaglig eller bevegelsesfaglig utdanning (f.eks. fysioterapi, idrettsvitenskap, idrettslærer eller beslektede fag). 
  • Førsteamanuensiskompetanse i tråd med Forskrift til UH-loven og HVLs retningslinjer. 
  • Dokumentert utdanningsfaglig kompetanse (pedagogisk mappe) i henhold til nasjonale krav. 
  • Solid erfaring med undervisning og veiledning i høyere utdanning. 
  • Dokumentert erfaring fra programutvikling, utdanningsledelse, kvalitetsarbeid eller tilsvarende. 
  • Faglig kompetanse innen undervisning human fysiologi, både grunnleggende og anvendt. 
  • Interesse for, og vilje til å utvikle kompetanse innen digital helse, bærekraft, relasjonspraksis og profesjonsdannelse. 
  • Vitenskapelig kompetanse og erfaring som muliggjør integrasjon av forskning, utdanning og programutvikling i komplekse profesjonsutdanninger. 
  • Erfaring med samarbeid på tvers av fagområder. 
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk eller annet skandinavisk språk. 
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på engelsk.

Det vil bli lagt særlig vekt på: 

  • Dokumentert utdanningsfaglig kompetanse  
  • Erfaring med programutvikling og utdanningsledelse 
  • Pedagogisk innovasjon og kvalitetsutvikling
  • Forskning og utviklingsarbeid relevant for fagområdet 
  • Erfaring med tverrfaglig samarbeid 

Forsknings- eller utviklingerfaring er ønsket, men må være relevant for utdanning, praksismodellutvikling, bevegelsesfag, humanfysiologi eller helsefremmende arbeid.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • Erfaring fra tverrprofesjonelt samarbeid eller tjenesteutvikling.
  • Erfaring med samhandling mellom helse og idrett, eller mellom forebygging, helsefremming og rehabilitering. 
  • Erfaring med internasjonalt samarbeid eller utviklingsprosjekter. 
  • Erfaring med søknadsarbeid og ekstern finansiering. 
  • Kompetanse innen læringsdesign, vurderingsutvikling og utdanningsinnovasjon. 
  • Interesse for profesjonens rolle i samfunnet i lys av teknologi, demografi, klima og tjenesteutforming.

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Relasjonell og inkluderende med evne til å bygge gode samarbeidsarenaer. 
  • Analytisk og strategisk med evne til å se helhet og utviklingsbehov. 
  • Endringsorientert, nysgjerrig og utviklingsvillig. 
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig, men også bidra aktivt i kollegialt samarbeid. 
  • Trygg formidler med gode pedagogiske og kommunikative ferdigheter.

Utdanningsfaglig kompetanse

Utdanningsfaglig kompetanse er et krav i alle undervisnings- og forskerstillinger.

For stilling som førsteamanuensis skal utdanningsfaglig kompetanse dokumenteres med en pedagogisk mappe og en pedagogisk cv i tråd med Kvalifikasjonskrav til utdanningsfaglig basiskompetanse for ansettelse, opprykk og overgang ved HVL - Høgskulen på Vestlandet. 

Språkkrav

Undervisningsspråket er norsk og søkere må beherske norsk eller annet skandinavisk språk godt muntlig og skriftlig.

Dersom søkere ikke tilfredsstiller språkkravet vil HVL legge til rette for at kompetansen oppnås innen 3 år fra ansettelsestidspunkt og søker forplikter seg til å gjennomføre kurs i norskopplæring innen 3 år fra tiltredelse.


Hvordan søke på stillingen?

Send søknad og CV ved å klikke på knappen merket ”Søk stillingen” på denne siden.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søknader blir vurdert ut fra den informasjon som er lagt inn i www.jobbnorge.no ved søknadsfristens utløp. Det er søkers ansvar å sørge for at alle relevante vedlegg er lagt inn innen fristen, herunder de vitenskapelige arbeidene (inntil 15 stk.), fullstendig publikasjonsliste, attester og vitnemål samt dokumentasjon på utdanningsfaglig kompetanse.

For førsteamanuensis skal  utdanningsfaglig kompetanse dokumenteres med en pedagogisk mappe og en pedagogisk CV i tråd med Kvalifikasjonskrav til utdanningsfaglig basiskompetanse for ansettelse, opprykk og overgang ved HVL - Høgskulen på Vestlandet.

Dersom vitnemålene, karakterutskrifter eller annen dokumentasjon ikke er på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk, må søker selv laste opp attesterte omsettinger. Hvis vedleggene overskrider 25 MB må de komprimeres før opplasting eller legges ved som lenke.

Søkere med utenlandsk utdanning må i tillegg dokumentere at utdanningen samsvarer med norsk bachelor-, master- eller ph.d.-grad.  Se www.hkdir.no for mer informasjon om vurdering av høyere utdanning. 

HK-dir tilbyr automatisk godkjenning for enkelte grader fra utvalgte land. Dersom utdanningen til søkeren er dekket av ordningen med automatisk godkjenning, vil det være tilstrekkelig å legge ved dokumentasjon på dette. Du kan lese mer om ordningen med automatisk godkjenning her.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søknad om vurdering gjennom den ordinære godkjenningsordningen til HK-dir kan ta tid. Du bør derfor sende søknad om godkjenning så raskt som mulig når du vet at du vil søke på stillingen. Dersom du ikke har fått svar fra HK-dir innen søknadsfristen, legger du ved dokumentasjon fra HK-dir om at de har mottatt søknaden din. 

Søknadene blir sendt elektronisk til det sakkyndige utvalget. På bakgrunn av komiteens innstilling vil aktuelle søkere bli innkalt til intervju og prøveforelesning. Søknader kan ikke sendes på e-post til enkeltpersoner ved høgskolen.


Vi tilbyr:
  • Gode pensjons-, forsikrings-, og låneordninger i Statens pensjonskasse
  • Spennende fagmiljø med mulighet for kompetanseheving- og utvikling
  • Mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden

Stillingen som førsteamanuensis/førstelektor/høgskolelektor er lønnet etter Statens lønnsregulativ, i stillingskode 1011 førsteamanuensis

Fra lønn vil det bli trukket 2 % innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse.


Generell informasjon:

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at i henhold til ny offentlighetslov kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Søkere vil bli varslet dersom slik anmodning ikke tas til følge.

Den statlige arbeidsstyrken skal i størst mulig grad gjenspeile mangfoldet i befolkningen. Det er derfor et personalpolitisk mål å oppnå en balansert alders- og kjønnssammensetning, rekruttere personer med minoritetsbakgrunn, nedsatt funksjonsevne eller med hull i CV-en. 

Høgskulen på Vestlandet er underlagt eksportkontrollforskriften. Forskriften kan komme til anvendelse i behandlingen av søknadene.


Kontaktperson(er) ved Høgskulen på Vestlandet:

1) Assisterende instituttleder Joost Van Wijchen

Tlf: +47 55 58 78 55

E-post: Joost.Van.Wijchen@hvl.no

2) Tittel, navn, telefon


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Fakultet for helse- og sosialvitskap har 460 ansatte og 5500 studenter. Vi har et bredt utdanningstilbud innen helse- og sosialfaglige profesjonsutdanninger, etter- og videreutdanninger og flere masterprogram. Fakultetet tilbyr ph.d.-utdanningen "Helse, funksjon og deltakelse". I tillegg har Fakultet for helse- og sosialvitskap ansvar for forskningsområdet: «Innovasjon i offentlig sektor» i ph.d.-utdanningen Responsible Innovation and Regional Development (RESINNREG), som er et samarbeid på tvers av fakultetene.

Studentene våre får omfattende ferdighetstrening i tillegg til praksis, blant annet gjennom øvelser i kommunikasjon og utprøving ved et avansert simuleringssenter, SimArena.

Vi praktiserer fleksible læringsformer der studenten selv blir utfordret til å delta i forskning og utviklingsarbeid.

Ved Institutt for helse og funksjon er vi om lag 60 ansatte og 700 studenter med studiested i Bergen. Vi har bachelorutdanninger i ergoterapi, fysioterapi og radiografi. I tillegg har vi også masterstudium i klinisk fysioterapi med tre studieretninger, masterstudium i kunnskapsbasert praksis med tre studieretninger og tverrfaglig internasjonalt masterstudium i Healthy aging and rehabilitation. Forskning og formidling knyttet til disse fagområdene og utdanningsforskning er en viktig del av arbeidsoppgavene våre.

title: Interim Global Portfolio Lead, GBS Communication, Oslo
description:
We are looking for an experienced consultant for a six-month assignment with a large international company based in Oslo.

The role sits at the intersection of communication, digital development and business. You will help turn communication and channel strategy into clear concepts, priorities, governance, processes and actionable work packages for internal teams and external vendors.

This is not a traditional communications role, nor is it a purely technical or project management role. We are looking for someone who understands digital communication environments and who is strong at creating structure, alignment and progress in a complex global organisation.

The assignment

You will act as a key link between communication teams, digital development teams, the business and external vendors.

A central part of the assignment will be to strengthen governance and ways of working across the digital communication portfolio, helping the organisation move from strategic direction to clear priorities and execution.

You will, among other things:

  • support owners of communication and channel strategies in turning strategic priorities into actionable initiatives

  • translate business and communication needs into clear concepts, roadmaps and work packages

  • help structure, prioritise and govern the digital communication portfolio across teams, channels and vendors

  • establish and improve processes, governance and ways of working

  • coordinate initiatives across communication, technology and business functions

  • drive progress and ensure alignment across key stakeholders

  • prepare and present recommendations and decision material

  • coordinate and follow up external digital vendors and partners

  • ensure that solutions and initiatives are viewed in a broader cross-functional context

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced consultant who combines strong communication and digital understanding with the ability to drive execution.

You are likely to have experience within:

  • digital communication, transformation, programme, project or portfolio management

  • communication governance and process development

  • digital communication platforms such as web, intranet, digital workplace or similar environments

  • translating strategy and complex business needs into concrete concepts and deliverables

  • stakeholder management in large and complex organisations

  • working across communication, technology and business teams

  • coordinating internal teams and external vendors

  • preparing and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders and steering groups

Experience from large global companies and complex international matrix organisations is a strong advantage.

You do not need to be a technical specialist or developer, but you must understand how digital solutions are developed and managed, and be able to translate business and communication needs into something technical teams can act on.

Experience with digital workplace, intranet, web platforms, governance, vendor management, analytics or digital transformation is also an advantage.

Personal qualities

The personal fit will be important in this assignment.

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Professionally confident and comfortable providing clear recommendations

  • Diplomatic, with the ability to navigate different priorities and perspectives

title: Bussförare i Tromsø - Norge
description:
Är du redo för ett nytt äventyr i Tromsø? Bli en del av Tide och bidra till trygga och hållbara reseupplevelser varje dag.

Vill du kombinera ett tryggt jobb med spektakulär natur och oförglömliga upplevelser?
Tide söker både tillsvidareanställda och säsongsanställda bussförare (3-12 månader) till Tromsø, en av Nordens mest unika städer. Här får du möjligheten att arbeta i en professionell och inkluderande arbetsmiljö samtidigt som du får uppleva midnattssol, norrsken och fantastiska möjligheter till friluftsliv.

Som bussförare hos oss spelar du en viktig roll i vardagen för tusentals människor. Varje dag ser du till att våra passagerare kommer fram tryggt och säkert, samtidigt som du bidrar till ett mer hållbart samhälle.

Därför väljer många Tide:
- Fast och trygg anställning hos ett av Norges största bussbolag
- Konkurrenskraftig lön enligt kollektivavtal
- Gedigen introduktion och stöd från erfarna kollegor
- Hjälp genom hela processen med förarkort/körtillstånd
- Möjlighet till tillfälligt boende vid anställningsstart
- En trivsam arbetsmiljö med fokus på samarbete och arbetsglädje

Varför Tromsø?
Tromsø kallas ofta för Nordens Paris och erbjuder en unik kombination av stadsliv och storslagen natur.
- Upplev norrskenet under vintern
- Njut av midnattssolen på sommaren
- Åk skidor och gör toppturer precis utanför staden
- Paddla kajak, fiska och upptäck fantastisk natur året runt
- Ta del av ett rikt kulturliv med festivaler, konserter och evenemang

Vi söker dig som har:
- Körkort klass D
- YKB (Yrkeskompetensbevis)
- Körtillstånd för persontransport eller möjlighet att ansöka om detta (Tide kan hjälpa till)
- För att kunna kommunicera väl med passagerare, kollegor och trafikledningen måste du behärska norska, svenska eller engelska på minst B2-nivå.
- Ett tryggt, serviceinriktat och behagligt körsätt

Lön och villkor:
Tide följer Bussbranschavtalet (kollektivavtal).

Genomsnittslönen för bussförare ligger på omkring 603 000 norska kronor per år, beroende på anställningstid, yrkesbevis, kompetens och olika lönetillägg. Utöver grundlönen tillkommer bland annat kvälls-, helg- och skifttillägg samt eventuell övertidsersättning.

Boende vid anställningsstart:
Vi hjälper dig med boende under uppstartsfasen. Under de första sex månaderna står Tide för hyran i ett av våra rum eller lägenheter.

Om du vill bo kvar efter denna period kan du hyra bostaden vidare på egen bekostnad.

Söker du eget boende kan vi även hjälpa till med hyresgaranti, referenser och praktiskt stöd i bostadssökandet.

Vi hjälper dig med körtillstånd:
För att arbeta som bussförare i Norge behöver du ett norskt körtillstånd för persontransport.

Tide vägleder dig genom hela processen, inklusive ansökan, läkarintyg och nödvändig dokumentation. Handläggningstiden hos polisen är normalt mellan 2 och 6 veckor, därför rekommenderar vi att du påbörjar processen så tidigt som möjligt.

Du hittar mer information här: https://jobb.tide.no/jobs/8337235-bussforare-i-tromso-upplev-nordens-paris

In English:
Ready for a New Adventure in Tromsø? Join Tide and help create safe, sustainable, and enjoyable travel experiences every day.

Would you like to combine a secure job with spectacular nature and exciting experiences?
Tide is looking for both permanent and seasonal bus drivers (3-12 months) for Tromsø, one of the most unique cities in Northern Norway.

Here, you will have the opportunity to work in a professional and inclusive environment while experiencing the Midnight Sun, the Northern Lights, and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a bus driver with us, you play an important role in the daily lives of thousands of people. Every day, you ensure that passengers reach their destinations safely while contributing to a more sustainable society.

Why Choose Tide:
- Permanent and secure employment with one of Norway's largest bus companies
- Competitive salary through a collective bargaining agreement
- Comprehensive training and support from experienced colleagues
- Assistance with the passenger transport licence application process
- Opportunity for temporary accommodation upon relocation
- A positive working environment focused on well-being and teamwork

We Are Looking for Someone Who Has:
- Category D driving licence
- CPC (Certificate of Professional Competence) / YSK for bus drivers
- A Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel) or eligibility to apply for one (Tide can assist)
- To communicate effectively with passengers, colleagues, and the traffic control centre, you must have Norwegian, Swedish, or English language skills at a minimum B2 level
- A safe, service-oriented, and comfortable driving style

Salary and Working Hours:
Tide follows the Norwegian Bus Industry Collective Agreement.

The average annual salary for bus drivers is approximately NOK 603,000, depending on seniority, vocational qualifications, competence, and additional allowances.

The bus industry offers various supplements, including shift allowances, evening and weekend premiums, as well as overtime pay. Salary will vary depending on the shifts worked.

Working hours may include split shifts and work at different times of the day, including weekends and public holidays. Overtime pay and other supplements are regulated by the collective agreement.

Accommodation When You Start:
We help you with accommodation during your start-up period. For the first six months, Tide covers the rent for one of our rooms or apartments.

After this period, you may choose to remain in the accommodation and continue renting at your own expense. Monthly rent typically ranges from approximately NOK 8,000 to NOK 11,000, depending on the property.

If you prefer to find your own accommodation, we can also assist with a rental deposit guarantee, references, and practical support during your housing search.

We Help You Obtain Your Passenger Transport Licence:
To work as a bus driver in Norway, you must hold a Norwegian Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel).

Tide can guide you through the entire process, including the application, medical certificate, and required documentation. Processing times with the police are normally between 2 and 6 weeks, so we recommend starting the process as early as possible.

title: Associate Professor in Materials Science and Photoelectrocatalysis
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a full-time position as Associate Professor in the section of Electrochemistry at the Department of Chemistry.


About the Department and what they are looking for in this position

The research in the Section of Electrochemistry focuses on the materials science and fundamental understanding of electrochemical processes, and their utilization in sustainable energy conversion technologies. The section is at the forefront of solid-state ionics, particularly in the development of proton ceramic electrochemical cells, including intermediate-temperature fuel cells, electrolysers and membrane reactors. Central research themes include defect chemistry and ionic/electronic transport in materials and at interfaces, and kinetic processes at surfaces. 

This position will be part of a major effort towards development of emerging technologies. This is a joint initiative across several Faculties at the University of Oslo, and in particular related to a research theme on photo-electrocatalysis for clean production of energy carriers and chemicals.

Over the past decade, the research activities have expanded into photo- and electrocatalysis at low and ambient temperature, including CO2 conversion, artificial photosynthesis, and gas-phase (photo)electrochemical cells. These activities build on our long-standing expertise and infrastructure in high-temperature electrochemical systems.

The Section for Electrochemistry works closely with Sections for Catalysis, Inorganic Materials Chemistry, and Solid-state Physics and Quantum Technology within the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN), which provides access to a broad range of facilities with state-of-the-art instrumentation. 

The new associate professor is expected to take active part in and further develop these collaborations, and to make strategic use of this infrastructure in pioneering research on functional materials, photo- and electrocatalysis, and technology development within sustainable energy conversion. Computational materials science has taken a central role in the section’s activities, alongside extensive use of synchrotron facilities through the Swiss-Norwegian Beamlines (SNBL) at the European Synchrotron Radiation Facilities (ESRF).

The Section for Electrochemistry currently has two permanent faculty members and plays a central role in research and education in materials science and electrochemistry, with a strong focus on sustainable energy technologies. To consolidate and further develop the section’s activities in research, supervision and teaching, we seek to employ a new associate professor who will strengthen and expand our efforts in electrochemical energy conversion and related areas, and who will contribute the section’s development both in depth and in new directions.


More information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field, equivalent to an Associate professor position. The successful applicant must be able to teach at all levels and to supervise Master and PhD students. 

The successful applicant may furthermore be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks, by request from the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 


What skills are important in this role?

Required qualifications:

  • The successful applicant must have completed a PhD in physical or inorganic chemistry or materials science and have a strong scientific track record within the area of photo/electrocatalysis.
  • A strong track record and/or a clear potential for research that will lead to technology development. 
  • Scientific qualifications will play a major role, and the main emphasis will be on the candidate’s scientific production from the last five years.
  • Documented potential for acquisition of external funding
  • Pedagogical qualifications and teaching and supervision experience at all levels will be an important factor in the evaluation process and should be well documented in a teaching portfolio. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages, in order to be able to teach and otherwise be able to participate in all functions the position may involve. If the successful candidate does not have sufficient mastery of a Scandinavian language, equivalent to B2 level, the candidate will be required to learn sufficient Norwegian within  three years of employment.

Desired qualifications:

  • Candidates should be able to establish, lead and conduct research projects, also as a collaborator. A track record in scientific and administrative leadership is an advantage.
  • International network, outreach activities, collegiality, and the ability to create a good working environment will be part of the evaluation.
  • The person appointed will be requested to take on some administrative duties. Hence such experience will be an advantage.

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive and productive research environment
  • Networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 750 000 - to 880 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at 
u io.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.
If you have an i mmigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

We hope that you will apply for the position.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (1–4 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the near future
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships.

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Department of Chemistry is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. 

As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

title: Virksomhetsleder Miljø og samferdsel
description:
Vil du lede en virksomhet med ansvar for samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom?

Ålesund kommune søker en tydelig og utviklingsorientert virksomhetsleder for Miljø og samferdsel. Vi ser etter deg som vil lede en kompleks og viktig virksomhet med ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, drift og utvikling innen samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom.

Virksomheten har ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, planarbeid, drift, vedlikehold og utvikling innen samferdsel og kommunal infrastruktur. Ansvarsområdet omfatter blant annet kommunale veger, gang- og sykkelveger, parkeringsplasser, broer, kaier, trapper, parker, grøntområder, friområder, byrom, lekeplasser, offentlige toaletter og enkelte idrettsanlegg. Vinter- og sommerdrift er en sentral del av oppgavene. Virksomheten planlegger og gjennomfører også utviklingsprosjekter på kommunal veg og i offentlige rom, og følger opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund.

Som virksomhetsleder får du et helhetlig ansvar for fag, økonomi, personell og utvikling. Du skal videreutvikle en organisasjon med bredt ansvarsområde, sikre god drift og kvalitet, og bidra til samhandling på tvers av fagmiljø og samarbeidspartnere.

Virksomheten har tre avdelinger i dag:

  • Forvaltning
  • Drift
  • Prosjekt

Stillingen inngår i kommunalområde Samfunn, og du blir en del av ledergruppen. Sammen har ledergruppen ansvar for å videreutvikle og profesjonalisere kommunens tjenester.

Kommunens omdømme skapes av dyktige medarbeidere som hver dag bidrar med kompetanse, engasjement og samfunnsansvar på ulike arenaer.

 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil blant annet få ansvar for:

  • å lede og videreutvikle virksomheten i samsvar med kommunens mål og prioriteringer.
  • å sikre forsvarlig drift, forvaltning og myndighetsutøvelse innen virksomhetens ansvarsområder.
  • økonomi, budsjett, rapportering og ressursbruk innenfor vedtatte rammer.
  • å bidra til god gjennomføring av store investerings- og utviklingsprosjekter.
  • å følge opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund og andre samarbeidsprosjekter.
  • å legge til rette for medvirkning, kompetanseutvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen tekniske tjenester, samferdsel, ingeniørfag eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • ledererfaring med ansvar for økonomi, personell og fag.
  • erfaring fra kommunal sektor.
  • erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling, endringsarbeid eller komplekse drifts- og forvaltningsmiljø.
  • god forståelse for økonomistyring og offentlig forvaltning.

Det er en fordel med erfaring fra samferdsel, kommunalteknikk, drift av infrastruktur, prosjektgjennomføring eller andre relevante tekniske tjenester.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • er en tydelig og samlende leder.
  • har god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å prioritere.
  • kombinerer strategisk blikk med operativ forståelse.
  • bygger tillit og skaper gode samarbeidsrelasjoner i organisasjonen, med politikere og med innbyggere og næringsliv.
  • er utviklingsorientert og motiveres av et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.
  • har gode samarbeidsevner, tydelig kommunikasjon og endringskompetanse.
Vi tilbyr
  • en sentral lederstilling med stor samfunnsmessig betydning.
  • ansvar for en virksomhet med høy faglig kompetanse og viktige utviklingsoppgaver.
  • mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av kommunens samferdselsløsninger, infrastruktur og offentlige rom.
  • samarbeid med sterke fagmiljø og støttefunksjoner innen innkjøp, HR, kommunikasjon, juridiske tjenester og økonomi.
  • lønn etter avtale.
KontaktinformasjonSol Berntsen Slinning, Kommunalsjef, 402 92 327, sol.berntsen.slinning@alesund.kommune.no
ArbeidsstadKeiser Wilhelms g. 11
6002 Ålesund

Fast

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, og et regionsenter for Nordvestlandet. Kommunen har rundt 58.000 innbyggere. Området rundt byr på rike muligheter for et aktivt friluftsliv for alle, jakt og fiske, og kommunen har et rikt og blomstrende kultur- og næringsliv. Ålesund er en universitetsby og har landets største universitet, NTNU.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4.500 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

Ønsker du en meningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver, er Ålesund kommune et spennende alternativ.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Sous Chef, O´Conners Stavanger
description:
🍀 Sous Chef Wanted – O’Connor’s Irish Pub, Stavanger

Full-time | Start ASAP | 1–2 month trial through Staffers | Permanent opportunity

Are you an experienced chef ready to take more responsibility in the kitchen?

O’Connor’s Irish Pub Stavanger is looking for an experienced and reliable Sous Chef to join their team as soon as possible.

The position will initially be a 1–2 month full-time assignment through Staffers, giving both you and the restaurant the opportunity to make sure it’s a great match. If everything works well, the plan is for you to move into a permanent position directly with O’Connor’s after the trial period.

Located in the heart of Stavanger, O’Connor’s combines the atmosphere of a traditional Irish pub with a busy social environment and a kitchen serving classic, hearty pub food.

👨‍🍳 The role

As Sous Chef, you’ll play an important role in the daily operation of the kitchen.

You’ll work closely with the rest of the kitchen team, take responsibility during service and help make sure the kitchen runs smoothly, efficiently and consistently.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking responsibility for the kitchen and service when required
  • Preparing and cooking dishes according to the restaurant’s menu and standards
  • Managing your own section during busy services
  • Supporting and guiding other members of the kitchen team
  • Organising mise en place and preparation
  • Helping maintain good structure and workflow in the kitchen
  • Ensuring high standards of quality, cleanliness and food safety
  • Keeping calm and organised during busy periods
  • Cooperating closely with both the kitchen and front-of-house teams
  • Supporting the Head Chef and contributing to the overall operation of the kitchen

🔎 We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has solid professional experience as a chef
  • Ideally has previous experience as a Sous Chef, Senior Chef or Chef de Partie with additional responsibility
  • Is confident taking responsibility during service
  • Can work independently and make decisions when needed
  • Is organised, reliable and takes ownership of their work
  • Works efficiently without compromising quality
  • Is comfortable working in a busy, high-volume kitchen
  • Has a positive attitude and works well with others
  • Can communicate comfortably in English or Norwegian
  • Is available to start as soon as possible
  • Is interested in a long-term opportunity if the role is a good match

Experience from pub food, casual dining, à la carte or high-volume kitchens is a strong advantage.

⭐ What’s on offer?

  • Start as soon as possible
  • An initial 1–2 month trial period through Staffers
  • Clear opportunity to be hired directly by O’Connor’s after the trial period
  • A senior role with responsibility in the kitchen
  • A lively workplace in central Stavanger
  • A well-established restaurant and hospitality group
  • The opportunity to show what you can do before both sides commit long-term

📍 Location

  • O’Connor’s Irish Pub – Stavanger

title: Service Engineer- SeaQ Control
description:
VARD Electro is shaping the future of shipbuilding through advanced electrical, automation and integrated technology solutions. Through our SeaQ portfolio, we support our customers worldwide with reliable, intelligent systems that enhance safety, connectivity, and operational performance at sea.

Our Service Department is expanding, and we are looking for a Service Engineer in the SeaQ Control field to join us! SeaQ Control is VARD Electro's automation platform for monitoring and controlling vessel systems. The solution integrates alarm, monitoring and control functions and plays a key role in the safe and efficient operation of advanced vessels worldwide. You will join a specialized and collaborative environment where different disciplines come together to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the global maritime industry.

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 


Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in the commissioning and service of our SeaQ Control systems delivered to customers worldwide. You will work hands-on with advanced automation and control systems, both on board vessels and in-house, contributing to projects that ensure safe and efficient vessel operations.
Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and providing technical assistance to customers and colleagues. You will also participate in factory testing, reporting, and other in-house support activities.
This position involves extensive travel, and we are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving technical challenges, works well independently, and has a strong customer-focused mindset.

Qualifications
  • Technical background/education within Automation (Technician Level/ Bachelor/ Master)
  • Experience from commissioning, service, troubleshooting or maintenance of automation and control systems
  • Strong competence in PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks and instrumentation

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong technical understanding and interest 
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian and English
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Norwegian driver's license
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • Geographical / rotation flexibility
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

Ta gjerne kontakt om du skulle ha noen spørsmål.

title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003

title: Researcher in Applied Mineralogy
description:
About the position and project

The Natural History Museum (NHM) at the University of Oslo invites applications for a two-year, full-time position as a Researcher in applied mineralogy and industrial mineral exploration. The position will be based in the Department of Research and Collections, within the Norwegian Centre for Mineralogy Research Group. The position is part of the innovation industry-research project “PureQ – The Future of the High-Purity Quartz Value Chain for Improved Yield, Quality and Sustainability”, funded by the Research Council of Norway.

The successful and highly motivated candidate will have a strong publication record and demonstrated experience with modern, advanced microanalytical techniques for mineral characterisation, particularly of quartz. Relevant expertise includes crystal chemistry and microtextural characterisation. Experience in mineral exploration, especially geochemical exploration and drill-core logging, is also desirable.


Qualifications requirements 

Required qualifications:
•    A PhD in geology or mineralogy
•    Demonstrated ability to conduct elemental microanalysis using LA-ICP-MS, including data processing and interpretation
•    A recent publication record relevant to the subject area of the position
•    A strong upward academic trajectory

The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of English as working language. Proficiency in Norwegian is an advantage.

Desirable qualifications:
•    Familiarity with a range of microanalytical and spectrometric techniques used for mineral analysis besides LA-ICP-MS, such as SEM, EPMA, and CL


Personal qualities

  • Ability to meet project reporting deadlines consistently 
  • Willingness to travel frequently within Norway and abroad as part of the project
  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive, and productive research environment
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other staff members

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer

  • Building networks within the national geoscience and mineral industry sectors
  • Onboarding program for new employees
  • Good welfare schemes, in addition to Oslo´s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities 
  • Salary in position as Researcher (position code 1109) in salary range NOK from 620 000 to 720 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended either for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance up top four years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level

  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance.   • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.

  • Ability to work independently towards goals.

What we offer:

Are you ready to join our team?
