Jeg er en ung kvinne bosatt i Lillehammer som søker flere assistenter til BPA-ordningen min. Jeg ønsker å bygge et stabilt og trygt assistentteam som kan bidra til at jeg får en god hverdag og muligheten til å leve et aktivt liv på mine premisser.

For meg er det viktig at du er en person jeg kan stole på, som er trygg i deg selv og som kan håndtere både rolige og mer utfordrende dager. Det kan bli aktuelt å være med på turer og reiser.

Jeg søker tilkallingsvikarer. Arbeidstid vil kunne variere mellom dag-, kveld- og nattevakter, samt helg etter avtale.

Kjemien mellom oss er det aller viktigste. Du vil få god opplæring, og erfaring er ikke avgjørende dersom du er motivert for jobben.

  • Kjøring til aktiviteter og avtaler

  • Delta på ferier og reiser ved behov

Personlige egenskaper: 

  • Du er utadvendt, positiv og trygg

  • Du er tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • Du kommuniserer godt og bygger gode relasjoner

  • Du er løsningsorientert, strukturert og selvstendig

  • Du evner å stå stødig i krevende situasjoner

title: Front Office Supervisor  (Empfangschef/in (Hotel))
description:
Front Office Supervisor

Opis firmy

Tworzymy wyjątkowe miejsce dla naszych Gości dzięki wspólnej pasji do nowoczesnego designu i wysokiej jakości obsługi.

Już ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast.

Dołącz do naszego zespołu w Gdańsku!

Odkryj możliwości pracy w miejscu, gdzie liczy się pasja, zaangażowanie i chęć rozwoju!

Opis oferty pracy

Twoim priorytetem będzie troska o dobre samopoczucie Gości i Pracowników!

Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również:

- Meldowanie Gości, sprawdzanie listy przyjazdów oraz innych raportów
- Zapewnienie profesjonalnej, najwyższej jakości obsługi
- Monitorowanie oraz reagowanie na opinie Gości

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

Czy posiadasz wyjątkową osobowość oraz doskonałe umiejętności z zakresu gościnności?

title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;
- Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analitycznego myślenia;
- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

title: TRABALHADOR NÃO QUALIFICADO DA FLORICULTURA E HORTICULTURA
description:
Pretende-se recrutar um/a Jardineiro/a para integrar a equipa da Yucca Paisagismo, empresa dedicada à criação, implementação e manutenção de espaços verdes e jardins, com foco na qualidade, estética e cuidado dos espaços exteriores.

O/a profissional deverá ter experiência ou conhecimentos na área de jardinagem e manutenção de espaços verdes, demonstrando gosto pelo trabalho ao ar livre, sentido de responsabilidade, atenção ao detalhe e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autónoma e em equipa.

As principais funções incluem a manutenção e tratamento de jardins, nomeadamente poda de árvores, arbustos e plantas, corte e manutenção de relvados, controlo de infestantes, adubação e tratamentos fitossanitários, rega e manutenção de sistemas de rega, plantação e transplante de espécies, limpeza e organização dos espaços exteriores e apoio na implementação de novos jardins e projetos de paisagismo.

Procura-se uma pessoa responsável, assídua, organizada, dinâmica e cuidadosa, com capacidade para seguir orientações técnicas e manter elevados padrões de qualidade no trabalho realizado. Valoriza-se experiência com diferentes espécies vegetais, conhecimentos de identificação e necessidades das plantas e experiência na utilização e manutenção de ferramentas e equipamentos de jardinagem.

Será valorizada a experiência profissional anterior na área, bem como carta de condução e facilidade de deslocação entre diferentes locais de trabalho. A capacidade de trabalhar em equipa, o bom relacionamento interpessoal e uma atitude proativa serão igualmente considerados fatores importantes.

title: TÉCNICOS E ASSISTENTES FARMACÊUTICOS
description:
COLABORADOR(A) PARA INTEGRAR A EQUIPA DA FARMÁCIA, PREFERENCIALMENTE FARMACÊUTICO(A) OU TÉCNICO(A) DE FARMÁCIA. NO ENTANTO, ESTAMOS TAMBÉM RECETIVOS À INTEGRAÇÃO DE ESTUDANTES DA ÁREA DAS CIÊNCIAS FARMACÊUTICAS/FARMÁCIA QUE TENHAM INTERESSE EM CONCILIAR OS ESTUDOS COM UMA EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL EM FARMÁCIA COMUNITÁRIA.
A VAGA DESTINA-SE A REFORÇAR A EQUIPA DURANTE UMA LICENÇA DE MATERNIDADE, COM INÍCIO PREVISTO ENTRE AGOSTO E SETEMBRO DE 2026, EM REGIME DE PART-TIME (CERCA DE 20 A 25 HORAS SEMANAIS). TRATA-SE DE UMA FARMÁCIA COMUNITÁRIA EM VILA NOVA DE POIARES, A APROXIMADAMENTE 30 MINUTOS DE COIMBRA, INSERIDA NUM CONTEXTO RURAL E COM UMA FORTE LIGAÇÃO À COMUNIDADE.
PROCURAMOS UMA PESSOA RESPONSÁVEL, AUTÓNOMA, COM BOA CAPACIDADE DE COMUNICAÇÃO E INTERESSE PELA ÁREA DA FARMÁCIA COMUNITÁRIA. A INTEGRAÇÃO SERÁ FEITA NUMA EQUIPA ESTÁVEL, ATUALMENTE COMPOSTA POR TRÊS FARMACÊUTICOS E UM TÉCNICO AUXILIAR DE FARMÁCIA.

title: Italian-Speaking Technical Support Specialist (m,f) : Drone (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start: 03.08. or 01.09.26

We are partnering with a global technology company to recruit Italian-speaking Technical Support Specialists for a new project based in Italy.

In this role, you will provide professional technical assistance and customer support to users of cutting-edge camera drones. You will guide customers through troubleshooting, product usage, and problem resolution while ensuring an excellent overall experience. This is a great opportunity to work in a fast-paced, international environment with the latest technology.

Your Role
Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat in Italian.
Troubleshoot and resolve product-related issues with camera drones.
Assist customers with setup, functionality, and maintenance guidance.
Educate users on features, firmware updates, and common usage issues.
Log and manage cases accurately in internal systems.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to escalate complex technical problems.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through timely and professional communication.

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1 level)
Basic knowledge of English for internal communication
Previous experience in technical support, IT, or electronics is preferred
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, international environment
Interest or experience in drones, consumer electronics, or related technology is a plus

The Offer
Full-time position with a structured onboarding and paid training
Hybrid working model (office + remote) depending on operational needs
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Career development opportunities within an international tech company
Work in a collaborative, international team and gain exposure to cutting-edge technology

title: Cuisinier (H/F)
description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. Team Leadership & People Development

•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.

Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

Clear and professional customer communication skills.

Experience in hosting, cloud services, SaaS, or telecommunications.
Knowledge of recurring billing and international payments.
Confident Excel or Google Sheets skills.
Basic understanding of accounting principles.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.
- Lead the solution-building process and engage pooled central inside sales specialists and presales experts when needed.
- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.
- Have 1–3 years of relevant industry sales experience.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**  

- Full-time, permanent contract, 39 hours/week: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00
- Base salary of 20,976 euros gross/year + up to 7,400 euros gross/year in bonus + private medical insurance
- Location at either our Barcelona, Malaga or Valencia office, or remote from Spain, if you are not based at one of these locations (except Canary Islands)
- Full paid training about the company and the project you will be working on
- Career development program and specialized courses

**Experience the best version of you!**  

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.  

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”  

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer  

*We're proudly united as one team, one company, globally. We're committed to equal employment opportunities for all candidates and a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All our recruitment practices are based on business needs, job requirements, and professional qualifications, without regard to race, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, family or parental status, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable national laws.*

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.
- Lead the solution-building process and engage pooled central inside sales specialists and presales experts when needed.
- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.
- Have 1–3 years of relevant industry sales experience.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**  

- Full-time, permanent contract, 39 hours/week: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00
- Base salary of 20,976 euros gross/year + up to 7,400 euros gross/year in bonus + private medical insurance
- Location at either our Barcelona, Malaga or Valencia office, or remote from Spain, if you are not based at one of these locations (except Canary Islands)
- Full paid training about the company and the project you will be working on
- Career development program and specialized courses

**Experience the best version of you!**  

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.  

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”  

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer  

*We're proudly united as one team, one company, globally. We're committed to equal employment opportunities for all candidates and a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All our recruitment practices are based on business needs, job requirements, and professional qualifications, without regard to race, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, family or parental status, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable national laws.*

description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

title: Junior kampagne specialist for Google Ads i Barcelona
description:
Er du klar til at forlade Danmark og det regnfulde vejr til fordel for den livlige, spændende og smukke by Barcelona? Og kunne du tænke dig at tilføje værdifuld arbejdserfaring med Google Ads til dit CV? Så er dette måske noget for dig!

Barcelona er hjemsted for mange store kunstnere og malere, så der er altid masser af kunst at udforske. Byens mest berømte kulturelle mesterværk er Gaudís værk, den imponerende katedral "Sagrada Familia," som repræsenterer en unik stil inden for moderne arkitektur.

Hvis du ikke er så vild med kunst og kultur, kan du tilbringe dagen på en af Barcelonas sandstrande, som kun ligger en kort gåtur fra byens centrum. Her kan du nyde noget af det bedste middelhavsinspirerede seafood. Byen har et ry for at være den mest kosmopolitiske, moderne og fremsynede by i Spanien. Selvom det er en meget moderne by, finder du stadig de gamle kvarterer som det gotiske kvarter, hvor byens ældste bygning ligger, samt utallige barer og butikker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og bonussystem

  • Udviklingsmuligheder inden for virksomheden

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, sociale arrangementer og et kontor med havudsigt

  • Relocation-pakke (Betalt fly til Barcelona og den første måneds husleje betalt + økonomisk bolig støtte din anden måned)

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Gratis fitnessmedlemskab

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om jobbet:

Som junior kampagne- og marketingspecialist vil du være ansvarlig for at forbedre og udvikle kampagner. Derfor vil du skulle rådgive og have gode forhandlingsevner – det er ikke aggressivt salg, men det er vigtigt, at du besidder nogle salgsmæssige kvaliteter. Dit daglige arbejde vil inkludere opgaver som:

  • Fungere som en betroet konsulent og onboarde kunder

  • Udvikle PPC-kampagner

  • Forstå kundernes behov og mål

  • Ansvar for at øge forbrug, mersalg og bæredygtighed

  • Håndtere en stor mængde potentielle kunder dagligt via telefonopkald

Dine kvalifikationer

Du taler dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

Erfaring: Minimum 1-2 års erfaring inden for salg og/eller online annoncering. Erfaring med outbound-opkald og salg (ikke påkrævet). BA/BS i Marketing, Digital Marketing eller Kommunikation er et plus.

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

Stærke kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner. Du er serviceorienteret, professionel og grundig.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at sende en mail til Cll@jobsqd.com


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Customer Representative (Swedish-speaking) - On-Site SP02

Ta ett jobb där du bidrar till att skapa en skillnad i människors liv! Tycker du om att hjälpa andra och trivs med att använda telefoner och datorer som en del av ditt dagliga arbete? Bli en del av ett företag med högt i tak och där du utvecklas!



Vi erbjuder dig ett fartfyllt jobb, härliga kollegor och utveckling 

Du kommer att få utbildning och kontinuerlig coaching av dina chefer och ditt team. Lära dig nya arbetsmetoder, utveckla din kommunikationsförmåga samt arbeta i en digital miljö med några av marknadens mest innovativa tekniker. Det du kommer att lära dig hos oss kommer att göra dig till en värdefull medlem av vårt team, eller vilket annat team som helst.



Hos Concentrix erbjuder vi:

- Attraktiva lönevillkor

- En bonus på 300 euro och uppåt när du får vänner anställda

- Tills vidare anställning, roterande schema: mån. till fre. 08:00 - 18:00, lör. 09:00 -17:00, med två lediga helger mer månad.

- Ett modernt kontor med öppen och trevlig planlösning

- Flyttstöd i förekommande fall



Vad du kommer att uppleva hos Concentrix 

Som en del av det Specsavers team kommer du att:

- Hantera inkommande och utgående samtal till befintliga eCommerce kunder samt online chatt.

- Hjälpa dem med deras frågor om beställningar, produkter, leveranser, erbjudanden och mycket mer, med fokus på bra service och ett gott bemötande

- Hantera samtal som inte besvaras av butiker och lämna kundförfrågningar via Customer Relation Management systemet

- När du har skaffat dig erfarenhet, ha möjligheten att hantera förfrågningar via sociala medier och email

- Ha fokus på att ge bra kundupplevelser i varje kundkontakt - inklusive fokus på ständig förbättring av vår kundnöjdhet

- Arbeta tillsammans med din grupp för att nå Specsavers uppsatta mål



Vem vi skulle vilja ha med i laget

Vi vill träffa människor från alla typer av bakgrunder, som tycker om att lära sig nytt och är nyfikna. Din naturliga talang för att hjälpa andra och göra det lilla extra för våra kunder kommer att passa in i det vi gör på Concentrix.

Vi letar efter dig som: 

- Har modersmålsnivå i svenska, är flytande i engelska och kan genomgå en utbildning på engelska utan problem

- Är proaktiv i ditt sätt att arbeta och nyfiken på att lära dig Specsavers tjänster, produktutbud och processer

- Har god erfarenhet av att arbeta med dator

- Har hög serviceförmåga, är tålmodig och kan hantera missnöjda kunder på ett professionellt och positivt sätt

- Är öppen för en ständigt omväxlande arbetsmiljö

- Är fokuserad på att arbeta proaktivitet, självgående och resonerar lösningsorienterat i ett team.

Det skulle vara toppen om du dessutom:

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med CRM system, samt kan hantera flertal system samtidigt

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta B2C

Uppfyller du inte alla krav? På Concentrix är vi engagerade i att skapa en mångsidig och inkluderande arbetsplats där alla kan lära sig och utvecklas professionellt. Om du känner att du inte kryssar i alla kvalifikationer i arbetsbeskrivningen uppmuntrar vi dig att ansöka hur som helst. Vi kommer att göra vårt bästa för att matcha dig med rätt jobb, oavsett om det är det här jobbet eller en framtida roll.



Låter det som dig? Välkommen till Concentrix! 

Om Concentrix i Málaga

Vårt kontor ligger strax utanför Málaga, i Benalmadenas beach-område. Málaga är inte bara den spanska staden med den bästa livskvaliteten (Eurobarometer) och känd för sina lokala artister som Antonio Banderas och Pablo Picasso. Malaga är också en stad med puls och hemvist för många välkända internationella högteknologiska företag.

Utanför arbetet har du 160 km kust och stränder att njuta av, ett spännande och hälsosamt kök, natur och nattliv! Gillar du sport, padel kanske? Det finns över 10 padelklubbar inom en radie på 20 minuter från ditt arbete. Och 320 dagar med solsken!

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

You connect with customers who already know and trust the brand.
And you help them order smarter, cheaper, and better.

No cold leads. No scripts.
Just meaningful conversations and sales that make sense.

About the Role

We are working on behalf of a well-established European e-commerce business within the office supplies sector, known for its strong reputation and loyal customer base.

As a Sales Agent, you’ll play a key role in strengthening customer relationships while identifying opportunities to add value through smart product recommendations.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Calling existing German-speaking customers **(warm leads only)**
- Advising on printers, cartridges, toners, and office supplies
- Recommending alternative or home-brand products where relevant
- Identifying upselling opportunities (bundles, larger quantities, better-value deals)
- Ensuring accurate and smooth order processing
- Collaborating closely with your team to deliver great customer experiences

This role is all about trust, understanding customer needs, and delivering real value—not aggressive selling.

What You Bring

- Native-level German
- Strong communication skills and confidence on the phone
- A commercial mindset with the ability to spot opportunities
- High attention to detail when managing orders
- A proactive attitude and eagerness to learn and grow

Sales experience is a plus, but not essential—motivation and mindset are key.

Why This Role Stands Out

This isn’t a typical sales role:

- No cold calling
- No pushy tactics
- No anonymous leads

Instead, you’ll benefit from:

- An existing, loyal customer base
- Clear and straightforward product offerings
- Honest upselling that benefits both the customer and the business
- A supportive environment focused on development

What’s in It for You?

- Live and work in sunny Valencia, Spain
- Breakfast and lunch provided at the office
- Spanish health insurance included
- Free Spanish language lessons
- Career development and growth opportunities
- Monthly team events, sports, and social activities
- Full relocation support to help you settle in smoothly

Ready to Get Started?

If you enjoy building relationships, spotting opportunities, and working in an international, fast-paced environment—this is your chance to grow your career while enjoying life in Spain.

title: Team Leader Nurse Team
description:
Lead a Team of Registered Nurses Providing Medical Assistance Worldwide

Are you an inspiring leader who wants to make a difference every day?

At Viking Travel Care, we help travellers who become ill or injured while abroad. From our offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain, we provide travel and medical assistance services 24/7, 365 days a year to customers and travellers worldwide.

We are now looking for a Team Leader for our Medical Assistance Coordinator (Nurse) team.

Our Nurses are experienced Registered Nurses from the Nordic countries. They assess medical reports, coordinate treatment, communicate with healthcare providers around the world, handle own medical cases, and support travellers during some of life's most challenging moments. They also serve as an important medical resource for colleagues across the Travel Care operation.

As Team Leader, you will have day-to-day personnel responsibility for a team of highly skilled nurses, supporting their development and helping ensure that the Medical Assistance team works in a structured, professional, and reliable way.

You will work closely with Viking Travel Care's Medical Management and Operations Management teams, as well as fellow Team Leaders, to support the continued development of our medical assistance services. In this role, you will act as an important link between the Medical Assistance team and management, helping translate strategic priorities into daily operations, quality improvements, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare expertise with people leadership in an international and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

    Personnel responsibility for a team of Medical Assistance Coordinators (nurses)
    

    Conduct performance reviews, development conversations, and regular follow-up meetings
    

    Drive employee engagement, professional development, and competence building within the team
    

    Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members
    

    Ensure delivery of agreed service levels, KPIs, and quality standards
    

    Monitor workloads, staffing, and operational priorities
    

    Support daily operations and assist with complex cases when needed
    

    Handle administrative responsibilities such as scheduling, absence follow-up, and workforce planning
    

    Promote high clinical and documentation standards
    

    Ensure compliance with SOPs, routines, and quality requirements
    

    Support the implementation of new processes, routines, and quality initiatives within the Medical Assistance team
    

    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects across Travel Care

Qualifications Required

    Experience from healthcare, medical assistance, travel assistance, insurance, customer service, operations, or another relevant field.
    

    Fluent in one of the Nordic languages and English
    

    Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    

    Comfortable working in a dynamic and international environment
    

    Strong IT skills and ability to quickly learn new systems
    

    Clean criminal record

Preferred

    Relevant experience in people leadership, team coordination, employee development, or similar responsibilities.
    

    Registered Nurse holding a valid nursing licence recognised within the EU, with a minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience
    

    Experience from travel assistance, insurance medicine, emergency care, intensive care, ambulance services, acute care, or similar fields

What can we offer the right candidate?

    Competitive salary and employment conditions
    

    Permanent employment contract under Spanish labour law
    

    Employer-provided laptop and mobile phone
    

    Comprehensive onboarding and training programme
    

    A supportive and collaborative work environment with highly skilled colleagues
    

    Social activities and team events
    

    Modern offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola
    

    The opportunity to work in an international organisation helping travellers worldwide

Are you the one we're looking for?

The right person for this position is a positive and approachable leader who enjoys helping others succeed. You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing operational priorities with employee development. You are organised, solution-oriented, and focused on creating clear and reliable ways of working for your team. You enjoy working closely with others while also taking ownership and acting independently when needed.

Most importantly, you believe that great customer care starts with strong teamwork, professional judgement, and clear, friendly communication.

About Viking

Viking Assistance Group is a leading roadside and travel assistance company in the Nordics. Viking Travel Care is the group’s travel and medical assistance division, providing assistance services 24 hours a day, 365 days a year to travellers and employees abroad. Across our services, we aim to make assistance easy to access, reliable in delivery, and friendly in every interaction.

Workplace

The position will be based at Viking Travel Care in Torrevieja or Fuengirola, Spain.

Working Hours

The role follows the Team Leader rotation and includes day, evening, and occasional weekend shifts, with flexibility needed to support a 24/7 operation when required.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Deadline

Please apply before September 30th

At Viking Travel Care, you will assist Nordic travellers around the world when they experience illness, accidents or other unexpected situations while travelling. You will provide important support to customers who need reassurance, information and practical assistance.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Answering telephone calls and emails
    Listening to customers and understanding their situation
    Opening and following up on cases
    Providing information about insurance coverage
    Assisting with arrangements involving doctors, clinics, transport, hotels or repatriation when required
    Working with insurance companies, doctors, clinics and other partners

Our assistance centre operates 24/7, and working hours are organised across daytime, evening, night and weekend shifts.

You do not need a particular educational background to apply. What matters most is that you enjoy helping people, communicate well and are comfortable working in a busy environment.

Experience in customer service, travel, healthcare, insurance, hospitality or other people-focused roles may be relevant, but it is not a requirement.

A background in areas such as languages, travel and tourism, healthcare, law, insurance or international studies may also be relevant, but is not required.

    Speaks and writes English confidently
    Is comfortable communicating by telephone and in writing
    Is organised and accurate

    Works well both as part of a team and independently
    Learns new systems quickly
    Is flexible and positive

    Thorough and structured training
    A competitive salary and good employment conditions
    A social and inclusive working environment
    Varied working days where you can make a genuine difference
    Opportunities for personal and professional development
    Attractive offices in Torrevieja or Fuengirola

How to apply

Please submit your application and CV. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Viking Travel Care assists travelers and expatriate employees around the world on behalf of travel insurance companies. We coordinate assistance for Nordic travelers and, through our global network of medical providers and partners, provide support in situations ranging from minor travel-related incidents to complex medical emergencies.

Viking Travel Care is part of Viking Assistance Group, a leading Nordic provider of roadside assistance, vehicle-related services and assistance solutions. Viking has offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain.

title: Arbetsterapeut inom LSS | Tiohundra
description:
Är du legitimerad arbetsterapeut och vill vara med och utveckla framtidens LSS i Norrtälje, Rimbo och Hallstavik? Vill du vara med och bidra till att möjliggöra ett tryggt och aktivt boende för våra brukare? Välkommen med din ansökan till ett härligt gäng där vi värdesätter samarbete, gemenskap och gott kamratskap.

Om tjänsten

Som arbetsterapeut inom LSS ingår du i ett team bestående av omsorgspersonal, sjuksköterskor, fysioterapeut och ytterligare en arbetsterapeut. Du handleder omsorgsteamen i ett rehabiliterande arbetssätt. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även journalföring i TakeCare, bedömningar, träning samt förskrivning av hjälpmedel. Våra kunder finns i hela Norrtälje kommun, vilket innebär att resor mellan orterna ingår i tjänsten.

Tjänsten är på 100% och tjänstgöring är dagtid måndag - fredag.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:

    Besöka patienter i hemmet och göra bedömningar
    Instruera och stötta patienten i sin rehabilitering
    Förskrivning av hjälpmedel
    Arbeta med fallprevention
    Samverka med sjuksköterska och omsorgspersonal inom LSS
    Utbilda omsorgspersonal inom LSS i ergonomi

Om vårt erbjudande:

Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr för år 2026.

Om dig

För den här tjänsten behöver du:

    Vara legitimerad arbetsterapeut
    Ha B-körkort för manuell växellåda
    Erfarenhet av professionen

Det är meriterande om du också har:

    Erfarenhet av LSS

Vi ser att du som söker gillar att arbeta självständigt, göra bedömningar och ta egna beslut. Du gillar när dina arbetsuppgifter är omväxlande och att vara en problemlösare. Då vi ser att vi lyckas bäst när vi jobbar tillsammans är det viktigt att du är en lagspelare som har lätt för att samarbeta. Då du själv i stor utsträckning planerar och lägger upp ditt dagliga arbete är det av viktigt att du som person är stabil, strukturerad och jobbar systematiskt.

Du delar vår värdegrund som bygger på delaktighet, trygghet och respekt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Om oss

Vi på Tiohundra är stolta över att erbjuda stöd och omsorg med hjärtat i fokus. Vårt mål är att skapa en trygg och meningsfull vardag för personer med funktionsnedsättning, där deras individuella behov och önskemål alltid står i centrum. Inom LSS erbjuder vi en varm och inkluderande miljö där alla ska få möjlighet att leva ett självständigt och rikt liv. Tillsammans strävar vi efter att göra skillnad, varje dag. Välkommen till oss!

Vi är en del av Tiohundra – det kompletta vårdbolaget i Roslagen.

Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm

Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.

Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Robottekniker - Installation & service av servicerobotar
description:
ROBIQ söker robottekniker 🤖

Gillar du teknik, att lösa problem och att förstå hur saker faktiskt fungerar? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig.

ROBIQ växer och vi söker en robottekniker som vill jobba med våra servicerobotar ute hos kunder runt om i Sverige.

Det här är inget jobb där du sitter vid ett skrivbord hela dagarna. Ena dagen installerar du en robot på ett hotell, nästa dag felsöker du hos en kund eller hjälper någon på distans. Du kommer att arbeta med både själva robotarna och deras appar och system.

Vad gör du hos oss?

Du kommer bland annat att:

    installera och konfigurera robotar hos våra kunder
    göra service, felsökning och reparationer
    hjälpa och utbilda kunder
    ge teknisk support
    testa, optimera och utveckla våra robotlösningar

Vi arbetar med flera olika typer av servicerobotar – bland annat robotar för städning, leverans och servering.

Vem söker vi?

Framför allt söker vi rätt person.

Du behöver vara tekniskt nyfiken, praktiskt lagd och tycka om att lösa problem. Du ska kunna jobba självständigt, men också vara bra på att möta människor – våra kunder ska känna att det är både enkelt och trevligt att få hjälp av ROBIQ.

Du kanske har jobbat några år som servicetekniker, mekaniker, installationstekniker, med automation, IT eller något helt annat tekniskt. Du behöver inte redan kunna robotar. Det viktiga är att du gillar teknik, lär dig snabbt och vill utvecklas.

B-körkort är ett krav. Du behöver också kunna svenska och engelska.

Om jobbet

ROBIQ är ett mindre företag som växer snabbt. Hos oss får du mycket eget ansvar och möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med företaget. Vi jobbar med ny teknik, men vårt viktigaste jobb är egentligen ganska enkelt: att se till att robotarna fungerar och att kunderna är nöjda.

📍 Placering: Västervik någon dag per vecka, för övrigt öppet för diskussion.

🚗 Tjänsten innebär resor till kunder, främst i Sverige. Övernattningar förekommer.

Nyfiken?

Skicka ditt CV och några rader om dig själv till info@robiq.se. Berätta gärna varför just du skulle passa hos oss.

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande.

Notera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar på annat sätt än via epost till adressen ovan. Du kan ej lämna in ansökan via olika jobbsajter då vi ej samarbetar med dem.

Vi undanber oss vänligen och bestämt kontakt från rekryteringsföretag, annonssäljare och andra leverantörer av rekryteringstjänster.

title: Däckmontörer

Vi söker nu flera däckmontörer till ett spännande och fartfyllt uppdrag inför kommande höstsäsong hos vår kund i Kungsbacka-området. Samtidigt är det viktigt att du är noggrann och ser till att arbetet håller en hög kvalitet. Det är ett fysiskt arbete som passar dig som gillar att vara aktiv under dagen.

Ort: Kungsbacka-området

Anställningsform: Detta är ett konsultuppdrag som varar under hösten 2026


Din profil


Krav:
