title: International Trainee  Fuel Engineer at Forsmark
description:
Job Description

Shape the future of energy.  

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.  

What you will experience  

Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.

Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.

Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

Your role as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

The Fuel Engineering team provides technical expertise within nuclear fuel, control rods and safeguards. The team leads and supports projects related to the reactor core and fuel, including core modifications, fuel repairs, procurement of control rods and nuclear fuel, fuel and control rod licensing activities, safeguards and planning of fuel transport. The work combines technical support, project coordination and long-term development of fuel-related activities at Forsmark Nuclear Power Plant.

As a trainee, you will support both ongoing operational activities and development initiatives. Your responsibilities may include:

Supporting activities related to nuclear fuel

Participating in inspections of nuclear fuel and control rods

Reviewing technical reports, analyses and documentation

Supporting technical investigations and evaluations

Analyzing operational and inspection data

Contributing to development improvement initiatives

Collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders to solve technical challenges

The work is varied and combines technical analysis with practical activities. You may spend one day reviewing technical reports and inspection results, and another day supporting activities in the reactor hall during planned outage periods.

You will work closely with experienced team members and gain exposure to many different parts of the business. The role is particularly suitable for someone who wants to build long-term expertise within the nuclear fuel area and develop as a technical specialist over time.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, preferably within Energy Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline

Excellent written and oral communication skills in Swedish and English

An interest in nuclear technology, energy systems and industrial operations

It is considered an advantage if you also have:

Experience of programming, scripting or data analysis is considered an advantage

Knowledge of MATLAB or similar tools is considered an advantage

Experience from technical projects, laboratory work or industrial environments is considered an advantage

An interest in process improvement and digitalization is considered an advantage

You should also recognize yourself in the following:

You are curious and eager to learn within a specialist field

You take responsibility and approach your work in a structured way

You work well both independently and together with colleagues and stakeholders

You are motivated by solving technical challenges and contributing to shared goals  

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027

Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles

Be fluent in English

Be available for the full-time programme from its start date

Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements

Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.

Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:  

You will be working in the Fuel Engineering team and located in Forsmark, Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer  

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations.

title: Junior Data Analyst/Product and Services Management
description:

title: Technical Support Engineer- EV charging & Battery Storage
description:
The role combines pre-sales technical support, solution design, customer training, commissioning, and after-sales support. You will work closely with customers, sales teams, R&D, production, installers, and other partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

· Provide pre-sales technical consultation and solution design for EV charging, BESS, and PV projects.

· Prepare technical solutions based on customer requirements and site conditions, including:

o System sizing and architecture

o Product selection and configuration

o EV charger, BESS, and PV integration

o Economic analysis to identify cost-effective system configurations

· Support the sales team with technical clarification, project discussions, and the preparation of technical proposals.

· Conduct customer training, product demonstrations, and technical presentations independently.

· Perform or support on-site commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and configuration of EV chargers and BESS systems.

· Provide after-sales technical support, including fault analysis, troubleshooting, and coordination with customers, installers, and internal engineering teams.

· Work closely with R&D and product teams to communicate field feedback and support technical issue resolution and product improvement.

· Travel mainly within Sweden, with occasional travel to other Nordic and European markets as required for commissioning, troubleshooting, training, customer visits, and other technical support activities.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation, or another relevant technical field.

· Good understanding of industrial low-voltage (LV) electrical systems, particularly 400 V three-phase systems commonly used in commercial and industrial applications.

· Familiarity with electrical components and equipment such as power cables, circuit breakers, protection devices, energy meters, current transformers (CTs), controllers, switches, relays, and electrical distribution equipment.

· Ability to understand basic cable sizing, electrical connections, power distribution, protection concepts, and equipment interfaces.

· Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, technical documentation, and system diagrams.

· Comfortable working hands-on with electrical and control equipment during testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.

· Able to independently perform basic system checks, equipment configuration, commissioning preparation, and fault diagnosis within the scope of the role.

· Strong interest in renewable energy, energy storage, EV charging, smart energy management, and electrification technologies.

· Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales teams, engineers, customers, installers, and other partners.

· Proficiency in English is required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are considered strong advantages:

· Previous experience in EV charging infrastructure, BESS, power systems, renewable energy, PV, EMS, or related technologies.

· Experience working with 400 V LV distribution systems, switchboards, electrical cabinets, meters, controllers, and related field equipment.

· Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, or technical support of electrical or power electronic equipment.

· Practical understanding of power cables, cable selection, CTs, energy meters, protection devices, and electrical measurement equipment.

· Experience using common electrical measurement and diagnostic tools during commissioning and troubleshooting.

· Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces such as Modbus TCP/RTU, OCPP, Ethernet, RS485, or similar industrial communication systems.

· Basic understanding of industrial networking, IP configuration, and communication between chargers, BESS, meters, controllers, and EMS systems is an advantage.

· Swedish or European electrical qualification/certificate, or relevant practical experience in electrical installation and commissioning.

Personal Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

· Technically curious and willing to continuously learn new products and technologies.

· Genuinely interested in the rapidly developing EV charging, energy storage, and renewable energy industries.

· Customer-oriented and comfortable communicating technical topics with different stakeholders.

· Hands-on and willing to participate in field testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning.

· Structured, responsible, and capable of managing multiple technical tasks or projects in parallel.

· Flexible and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-growing technical environment.

Epiroc i Kalmar söker nu en produktionsutvecklare inom logistik som vill bidra till vår fortsatta tillväxtresa. Här får du en viktig roll i att skapa stabila, effektiva och framtidssäkra logistikprocesser – med verklig påverkan på vår verksamhet.

I Kalmar tillverkar vi världsledande hydrauliska produkter för gruv- och anläggningsindustrin. Just nu befinner vi oss i en spännande utvecklingsfas där vi investerar i nya flöden, ökad automation och moderna arbetssätt i både produktion och logistik. Följ med när vi accelererar transformationen!

Bli en del av vårt team Du blir en del av ett engagerat team inom produktionsutveckling, där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och ett öppet klimat står i centrum. Här kombineras styrkan från en global koncern med flexibiliteten i en lokal organisation, vilket ger både stabilitet och möjligheter att påverka på riktigt.

I rollen arbetar du nära flera funktioner, såsom produktion, underhåll, supply chain, kvalitet och inköp, och rapporterar till chef för produktionsutveckling. Beslutsvägarna är korta och du har goda möjligheter att utvecklas, driva förändring och bidra till förbättrade logistikflöden och automationslösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta del av dina perspektiv och idéer!

Ditt uppdrag Som produktionsutvecklare inom logistik driver du förbättringar och förändringar i våra materialflöden och processer, kopplat till både nya produkter och nya arbetssätt. Ett särskilt fokus i rollen är utvecklingen av vårt höglager, där du är delaktig i införandet av automatiserade lösningar och nya flödesupplägg.

I rollen ingår att:•    utveckla och effektivisera lager- och logistikflöden genom hela produktionen•    vara Business Key User (BKU) för skeppning, lager, FactoryTrack och Fleet Manager•    driva och delta i projekt kopplade till automation och ny teknik inom logistik•    leda förstudier samt planera och genomföra förändringar i våra arbetssätt•    samarbeta med leverantörer kring tekniska lösningar och förbättringar

Rollen innebär en kombination av logistikförståelse och tekniskt intresse, där du bidrar till att utveckla både flöden och automationslösningar.

Placering och resorTjänsten är placerad i Kalmar. Enstaka resor kan förekomma.

Ansökan och kontaktI den här rekryteringsprocessen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-04.

För frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen eller ansökan vänligen kontakta: Maria Tedsjö, Rekryteringsspecialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com.För frågor om tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Fredrik Hägglund, Production Development Manager, fredrik.hagglund@epiroc.com

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:



•    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.

Profile description:

Din profilVi söker dig som är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och vill vara med och utveckla både dig själv och vår verksamhet. Du har ett intresse för teknik och en förståelse för hur automation, system och logistikflöden hänger ihop.



Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera analys med praktiskt förbättringsarbete. Kanske har du tidigare arbetat i en produktions- eller logistikmiljö där du varit med och utvecklat arbetssätt, drivit förändringar eller deltagit i projekt. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbetssätt, gillar att lösa problem och har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika funktioner.



För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:•    högskoleutbildning inom logistik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande•    erfarenhet av arbete inom logistik, produktion eller projektledning•    god vana av att arbeta i system, exempelvis Excel•    goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift



Har du erfarenhet av Lean-arbete eller automatiserade logistiklösningar ser vi det som meriterande.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

To match our growth journey, we will now strengthen our HRBP team. We are looking for HR Business Partner for business area Surveillance. You will be part of the Surveillance HRBP team who consists of 15 skilled colleagues supporting different Business Units within the Surveillance portfolio. Business area Surveillance is approximately 5800 employees internationally and will grow both in Sweden and internationally the coming years.

Your main tasks will be:

    Provide leadership in people and organisational areas; adding value in taking strategic and operational business decisions
    Support delivery of the people strategy within the management teams
    Equip the organisation with right capabilities and drive talent, succession and strategic workforce planning processes relevant to the business strategy and context
    Actively participate in business planning and strategy development for the business and provide people strategy plans to support business goals
    Act as a change agent and coach manager on how to handle change, engage employees and build capabilities effectively

Your profile

We believe you have a relevant university degree and extensive HR Business Partnering experience, furthermore you need:

    Strong business acumen, understanding of how the business agenda drives people imperatives and future organisational needs
    Previous experience in working as a HR Business Partner
    A continuous improvement mindset, pro-active attitude and agility
    Excellent interpersonal skills and effective relationship building across organisations
    Ability to balance the strategic and the operational with strong implementation and drive for execution
    Sound judgement and decision making
    A passion for continuous learning
    High energy, resilience and integrity
    Experiance from teknikavtalen is an advantage

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Quality Engineer - Workshop
description:
Quality Engineer - Workshop



Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.



As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



What you can expect

In our work environment, envision a fast-paced and high-energy atmosphere where your dedication to ensuring the highest standards of quality in our manufacturing processes will be not just encouraged but vital. Your role is pivotal in contributing directly to our steadfast commitment to delivering an unparalleled customer experience. Anticipate actively monitoring construction processes, conducting precise measurements and controls on products/components during manufacturing.



As a department, System Supply Chain Business Unit Separator technologies, we are driven by passion for our technology, products, and the processes they serve. We are responsible for designing, manufacturing, and delivering separator systems in various industries, such as Brewery, Beverage, Dairy, Biopharma and Industrial Fermentation, our commitment is unwavering. We consistently strive to provide our customers with nothing less than the best possible experience.



What you will do



    Your responsibilities extend to developing and maintaining instructions, procedures, and processes. Additionally, your involvement will play a key role in resolving internal deviations and addressing customer claims, reflecting the dynamic nature of our commitment to excellence in quality and customer satisfaction.



    You'll take the lead in monitoring manufacturing processes, verifying measurements, and maintaining control throughout production. Your work will include developing and improving governing documents, supporting deviation management, and addressing customer claims with precision and care.



    As a key contributor to our quality culture, you'll ensure measurement of equipment , drive continuous improvement, and lead investigations to identify root causes of non-conformities. You'll also prepare for and participate in internal and customer audits-helping us uphold our commitment to excellence and reliability.



    You'll work with a range of digital tools, including OPTO, D365, and other quality and production systems, to secure accuracy and efficiency across all factory activities-from incoming goods control, manufacturing to packing and delivery. Your expertise will help refine processes, strengthen guidelines, and ensure that every final check reflects our dedication to quality and customer satisfaction.





About you
You're curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by the challenge of making things better. With a relevant university degree and experience in quality engineering-ideally within mechanical or process manufacturing-you bring both technical knowledge and a practical mindset.



You're fluent in English and comfortable working in a global environment. You've successfully led product or process improvement initiatives and enjoy collaborating across teams to find smart, sustainable solutions.



A Six Sigma or Lean manufacturing certification is a strong advantage, as is experience in root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Most importantly, you share our belief that quality is not just a standard, it's a promise to our customers and partners.



If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and help shape a future defined by innovation, collaboration, and lasting positive impact.



For more information



Erica Hellström , Site Manager Jordbro,

Divya Sharma, Talent Acquisition Partner,

title: Senior Design Engineer
description:
Shape the Future of Tissue Technology as a Senior Design Engineer

Are you ready for the next step in your engineering career? Join a highly skilled team in Karlstad where you will help design market-leading tissue machines used by customers around the world. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues throughout the delivery chain, turning customer needs into tailored technical solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop both your design expertise and your involvement in customer projects while contributing to innovative, sustainable industrial solutions.

Your responsibilities

    You will create detailed drawings and technical documentation that support purchasing, manufacturing, and assembly of tissue machines.
    You will collaborate with engineers, project managers, production teams, and pre-assembly functions to deliver high-quality customer solutions.
    You will contribute to the ongoing development, maintenance, and improvement of products, machine sections, and components.
    You will translate customer requirements into practical and effective mechanical design solutions.
    You will support customer projects from design through delivery and occasionally travel when required.

Expectations for you

    You hold a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering and have experience in mechanical design.
    You have experience and a strong interest in mechanical product development and design engineering.
    You communicate confidently in written and spoken English.
    Experience from the paper, tissue, or process industry is considered a strong advantage.
    Some travel may be required as part of the role.

To succeed in this role

You enjoy combining technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and take ownership of your work from concept to delivery. Strong communication skills, problem-solving ability, and a structured approach will help you succeed in a role that involves close interaction with colleagues across engineering, production, and project teams. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve products and processes.

We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:

    Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
    Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
    Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
    Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer

You will join one of four engineering teams consisting of approximately 60 engineers working on world-leading tissue machine technology. The team combines expertise in mechanical design and technical project management, creating excellent opportunities for professional growth and knowledge sharing. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of specific machine sections and components, becoming a key technical expert within your area. The role provides close collaboration with production and pre-assembly teams, giving you a valuable end-to-end understanding of the products you help create.

At Valmet, you'll work in an international and people-focused environment where innovation, sustainability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do. We value continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional development, modern work tools, and a supportive culture where your ideas and contributions matter.

Want to know more?

Please send your application as soon as possible via the link provided, but no later than October 2nd, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Lars Gustavsson, Manager Dry End Section, at lars.o.gustavsson@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.   

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

Join the team and lead the way with us!

title: Research Coordinator
description:
Are you interested in working in an inspiring environment where you can support research and internationalisation? The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) Grants Office is looking for an experienced, skilled, and passionate Research Coordinator who is proactive, well-versed in external funding, and motivated to make a meaningful difference for researchers across the university.

The SLU Grants Office is a unit within the Division of Planning and Research Support. We provide expertise, support, advice, and information on external research funding to researchers, administrators, and university leadership. Our friendly, helpful, and professional team has a wide range of experience and expertise, enabling us to provide strategic and operational support both pre- and post-award. Our work focuses on proposal-writing advice and constructive feedback, budgeting, administration, and project management. We also provide information and capacity-building initiatives. We are currently based at SLU’s main campuses – Alnarp, Ultuna, and Umeå – but we all work to support the entire university.

Read more about the Grants Office at https://internt.slu.se/grantsoffice/.

Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/.

Duties:

As our new Research Coordinator, your primary role will be to work with SLU researchers who are leading applications for collaborative grants such as Horizon Europe Pillar II, MSCA Doctoral Networks, and European Partnerships, with flexibility to support other initiatives as needed. You will offer targeted advice and guidance to SLU coordinators during the pre-award phase, assisting with developing suitable concepts, reviewing proposal texts, and recommending improvements. Additionally, you will provide broader support across SLU through outreach, capacity-building and communication efforts.

More specifically, together with colleagues, you will:

    Support researchers applying for external funding, primarily by providing constructive feedback on proposal drafts and helping them craft a clear, persuasive narrative aligned with the scope of the call.
    Disseminate information about future funding opportunities, proactively identify prospective applicants, and encourage them to apply.
    Design and deliver seminars and workshops focused on funders, funding opportunities and proposal writing, and contribute to events co-organised with other units at SLU.
    Provide input on external funding strategies, including those discussed by SLU’s Strategic External Funding Team.
    Represent the Grants Office and SLU at internal and external networks.
    Support SLU Grants Office communications and outreach, including newsletters and web pages, and developing self-help training materials.

This list is not exhaustive and may change depending on SLU and the Grants Office’s needs. Depending on your personal competencies and interests, there is also scope to propose new initiatives and ways of working.

Please note that, due to the nature of the role, occasional domestic and international travel is required.

Qualifications:

Please use your application to demonstrate how you meet the essential and any applicable meritorious criteria listed below. We will place great emphasis on your personal suitability for the position.

Essential

    Experience working in research support within higher education or research institutes.
    The ability to understand complex funding calls and applications and to offer straightforward advice and guidance to academic colleagues.
    Experience with Horizon Europe Pillar II.
    Knowledge and understanding of national and international funding sources, including their guidelines and mechanisms.
    An excellent communicator, expressing yourself well in writing and speech.
    Confidence and flexibility of approach, with the ability to work independently and to collaborate with others.
    The ability to prioritise your own workload under pressure and meet set deadlines whilst maintaining a high degree of quality.
    Excellent people skills with the ability to develop professional relationships and networks at all levels within and beyond the university.
    Excellent command of the English language, written and spoken.
    An undergraduate degree.

Meritorious

    Postgraduate education and/or research experience.
    Experience working at research funding agencies or as an expert evaluator for proposals or projects.
    Experience with Marie Skłodowska Curie Doctoral Networks, European Partnerships, and other collaborative funding programmes.
    Knowledge of EU research policy.
    Experience writing or contributing to large research grant applications.
    Experience in outreach and communications, e.g. newsletters, webpages or blogs, or organising events.
    Experience in developing and delivering training sessions.
    Knowledge of how AI may be used appropriately, effectively, and responsibly in the context of research proposal support.
    Knowledge of the Swedish language, both written and spoken (SLU’s language policy requires staff to be able to understand information in Swedish after 4 years of employment).

Interview Process

Stage 1    Online interview in English (approx. 30 minutes) plus a written assignment (max. one hour).

Stage 2    In-person interview in English (approx. 1 hour).

Place of work

Ultuna (near Uppsala), Alnarp (near Lund), or Umeå. The position requires occasional domestic and international travel.

Form of employment

Substitute employment for 2 years, with the possibility of extension.

Extent

100%. Hybrid working is an option (max. 2 days per week).

Starting date

According to agreement.

Application

Please click the ‘Apply’ button below to submit your application. The deadline is October 9, 2026.

Union contact for recruitment

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/

title: Health & Safety Engineer
description:
Job Scope

High level purpose of function.

Supports the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company's health and safety management system.

Ensures compliance with applicable work environment legislation, regulations, and company requirements. Identifies, assesses, and supports the control of occupational risks through risk assessments, exposure monitoring, inspections, and incident investigations.

Supports managers and operational teams in the daily work environment and safety activities, including risk assessments, investigations, and follow-up of incidents, near misses, and risk observations.

Promotes a proactive safety culture and contributes to continuous improvement of health and safety performance.

Key Responsibilities

    Collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders across the organization to lead, coordinate, and advance systematic health and safety management and the development of a strong safety culture.
    Participates in the work of building up a Health & Safety management system in accordance with the requirements of ISO 45001 and Lyten's internal standards.
    Carry out training in health and safety.
    Compile and follow up KPI´s and report to management and other relevant parties.
    Support the organization in connection with risk assessments and other risk reviews.
    If necessary, support with investigations of incidents and accidents, with the aim of finding root causes and proposing measures to prevent it from happening again.
    Carry out investigations regarding physical work environment aspects such as exposure to chemical substances, noise, and ergonomic factors.
    Support the organization with expertise within health and safety.
    Inform, train, and coach leaders and employees in health and safety.
    Monitor and interpret changes in regulations.
    Manage or perform occupational exposure measurement.
    Manage and be superuser for existing systems regarding health and safety (TIA).
    Provide technical solutions for change management and new projects within health and safety.
    Lead or participate in health and safety related committees.
    Contacts with authorities.

Accountability/Authorization

    Budget responsibility: No
    Direct reports: No
    Manager work environment responsibility: No
    All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role.

    Degree in engineering, occupational health and safety, work environment engineering, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent qualifications demonstrated through education and professional experience.
    5+ years of work experience as a health and safety engineer, specialist or coordinator.
    Strong knowledge and experience with Swedish health and safety legislation, rules, regulations, and reporting processes.
    Good knowledge of data analysis and risk assessment methods.
    Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
    Experience in the battery manufacturing industry is a plus.
    Expertise in specific areas within health and safety, for example ergonomics, ATEX, or chemicals is a plus.

Specific skills

    Excellent English written and oral skills, Swedish is a plus.
    Highly organized and result driven.
    Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as independently.
    Has a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial spirit.
    Qualities that we cherish are flexibility, sense of quality, friendliness, motivation to take on new challenges

title: Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist
description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Improve production economics through operational financial analysis



Would you like to support investment and operational decisions through reliable financial analysis? As Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist, you will analyse production, testing and maintenance costs, identify financial risks and model future capacity scenarios. You will help Operations Karlskrona use resources and capital efficiently while NKT expands the cable production required for the green transition.







Translate operational costs into informed business decisions



Working within Operation Analytics, you will examine cost factors across production, testing, equipment, maintenance and material flows. You will connect financial information with capacity, staffing and operational forecasts, while considering energy prices, raw materials, inflation and policy developments. Your findings will support budgeting, forecasting, investment calculations and expansion planning.



Your responsibility will be to:




    Analyse cost factors across production, testing and material flows
    Prepare financial forecasts for capacity, staffing, equipment and maintenance
    Identify financial risks and opportunities within operational processes
    Support budgeting, forecasting and investment calculations
    Provide weekly cost signals and quarterly financial scenarios



The position is based in Karlskrona, Sweden, and involves close cooperation with Operations and Finance as well as other operational functions. You will support line organisations in using cost optimisation methods and models. Any travel requirements will be discussed during the recruitment process.





Profile description:

Commercially minded analyst with a practical operational approach



You are structured, curious and able to consider both financial and operational perspectives. You communicate complex findings clearly and enjoy working with colleagues from different functions. You assess assumptions carefully, ask relevant questions and provide balanced recommendations. You also take a collaborative approach to sharing methods and helping operational teams use financial information in everyday decision-making.



You also have:




    Experience analysing operational costs and cost variations
    Knowledge of financial forecasting and scenario planning
    Experience with budgeting and investment calculations
    Understanding of production, testing, maintenance or capacity economics
    Ability to prepare financial decision material from operational data







Support sustainable growth through better resource decisions



We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This position provides opportunities for career development, cross-functional collaboration and continued development of your financial and operational skills in an international environment. You will contribute to investment, capacity and resource decisions while learning from colleagues across Operations, Finance and related functions during NKT’s continued expansion.







“As a leader, I value clear analysis that helps our teams identify capacity constraints early and make well-founded operational decisions,” says Hiring Manager, Magnus Röstlund.







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 28.09.2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Dejan Zegarac, Global Talent Attraction Specialist, at Dejan.Zegarac@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.

title: SÄKERHETSMEDARBETARE - LÖVSTJÄRNAN FABRIKS AB
description:
Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB (LöFAB) is a Swedish defence manufacturing company established to support Nordic and NATO security-of-supply requirements through manufacturing, co-production, and lifecycle sustainment through partnerships and sub-contracts with global OEMs. LöFAB provides an EU-based industrial solution that enables compliant production, long-term support, and scalable capacity within Europe.

English version further down the page.

Lövstjärnan är en verksamhet där säkerhet, professionalism och service går hand i hand. Här är ordning och trygghet en naturlig del av det dagliga arbetet, och du blir en viktig del i att skapa en säker och välkomnande miljö för både medarbetare och besökare.

title: Account Executive
description:
About us Soundtrack is a B2B scale-up company providing music streaming services for businesses. We serve small customers like the café around the corner, and much bigger brands like Kiehl's, Spotify, Hard Rock Cafe & Four Seasons. On the inside, we're a team of talented, motivated, and humble individuals, including our dedicated Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams, alongside our expert Designers, Engineers, and Music specialists. We believe in product-led growth, where the product is the primary driver of customer acquisition, conversion and expansion.

The Role We’re looking for a driven, strategic, and relationship-focused Account Executive to join our Sales team in Sweden.

You’ll build strong relationships with larger multi-location businesses, ranging from 6 sites to hundreds, guiding them through consultative sales cycles and aligning key decision-makers. With a steady flow of inbound leads and a clear playbook, you’ll tailor solutions that create long-term value, often advising on audio setups, while maintaining momentum toward closing high-impact partnerships.

You’ll report directly to our VP Sales.

Responsibilities

    

Convert inbound leads from larger multi-location businesses (6+ sites) into long-term, high-value customers

    

Engage with prospects via email and video calls, building trust through consultative conversations

    

Navigate decision-making processes involving multiple stakeholders across different levels and departments

    

Tailor pitches to complex use cases, from restaurant groups to retail chains and service providers

    

Keep sales cycles efficient and maintain momentum while aligning all key decision-makers

    

Track your pipeline, forecast monthly MRR, and report on key conversion metrics

    

Collaborate with the Sales team to refine strategies for selling into larger organizations and share insights to continuously improve our sales approach

    

Advise prospects on commercial audio setups and address technical questions, ensuring they understand how Soundtrack fits into their environment. Hardware is expected to become a more significant part of our offering over time.

    

Work independently while staying closely aligned with the wider Sales team

About You You take ownership, think strategically, and thrive on building relationships that lead to long-term success. You’re comfortable managing a mid-market sales segment that includes both smaller and larger organizations. Sales cycles typically range from one week to several months, with an average of around 4–6 weeks.

You know how to qualify leads and prioritize your time effectively. You’re comfortable moving quickly when a shorter sales cycle is appropriate, while also having the patience and structure needed to manage larger and more complex deals.

You’re results-driven and persistent, but also empathetic and patient in your approach. You can adapt your pitch to complex organizational needs, ask the right questions, and guide prospects toward a clear decision.

Alongside your sales skills, you bring a solid understanding of commercial audio solutions, whether from working with Pro-AV integrators, audio hardware providers, or similar industries. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you know how to discuss and advise on technical setups in a clear and customer-focused way.

You balance momentum with attention to detail, ensuring that every interaction moves the deal forward while maintaining an exceptional customer experience. Naturally curious, you look for smarter ways to work, embrace feedback, and enjoy shaping solutions that create real business impact.

And if you love music like we do, even better!

Requirements

    

3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with a focus on consultative sales cycles and multi-location businesses

    

Proven ability to navigate complex decision-making processes involving multiple stakeholders

    

Strong communication and relationship-building skills

    

Solid experience with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar, as well as pipeline management

    

Experience closing deals with a comparable level of recurring revenue and complexity, ensuring familiarity with a similar sales motion

    

Based in Stockholm

    

Working knowledge of Commercial Audio / Pro-AV solutions, such as loudspeaker systems, amplifiers, and Audio over IP solutions like Dante, with the ability to discuss hardware setups in a clear and customer-focused way

    

Fluent English, including strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

    

Background from Pro-AV integrators, audio manufacturers, or similar industries where you’ve supported customers with technical audio solutions

    

Ability to bridge technical knowledge with consultative sales skills, acting as a trusted advisor to customers and colleagues

Employee Benefits

    

We offer a flexible workplace with the possibility to work remotely

    

Generous pension plan

    

Yearly budget for health, wellness and personal development

    

Laptop and mobile phone of your choice with included cellular subscription

    

Regular social activities such as team events, meet ups, after works and off-sites

    

Daily breakfast served at the office

At Soundtrack, we believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, abilities, religions, sexual orientations, and identities.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we identify a suitable candidate before the application deadline. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted via our career page and do not accept applications by e-mail.

title: Instrumentation Engineer – Project-Based Employment | Nevita | Nynäshamn
description:
Are you an experienced Instrumentation Engineer looking for a hands-on role in a complex process industry environment? Nevita is currently looking for an Instrumentation Engineer for an initial three-month project assignment at our client's site in Nynäshamn, with good opportunities for extension.

Your role

As an Instrumentation Engineer, you will work closely with operations, maintenance, engineering and other technical disciplines at an established process plant. The role combines engineering activities with practical, site-based support and is well suited to someone who enjoys working close to the plant and solving technical challenges in an operational environment.

Your responsibilities may include:

    

Engineering and technical support within instrumentation and control.

    

Working with P&IDs and translating process requirements into instrumentation solutions.

    

Selection and specification of instruments, control valves and associated equipment.

    

Working with pressure, flow, level and temperature measurement.

    

Reviewing I/O, instrument loops, datasheets and technical documentation.

    

Supporting modifications, upgrades and troubleshooting of existing installations.

    

Ensuring instrumentation solutions comply with applicable standards and requirements, including ATEX.

    

Coordinating with process, electrical, automation, maintenance and other engineering disciplines.

    

Supporting commissioning, testing, I/O checks and FAT/SAT activities when required.

    

Providing technical support to site activities, contractors and suppliers.

Your profile

We believe you have:

    

A technical degree in Instrumentation, Automation, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

    

Previous experience working with instrumentation in the process, petrochemical, refinery, energy or similar heavy industry.

    

Good understanding of P&IDs and industrial process systems.

    

Practical experience with instrumentation, I/O, loops, control valves and process measurement.

    

Knowledge of ATEX and instrumentation in hazardous areas.

    

The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with operations and other engineering disciplines.

    

Good communication skills in English.

Experience with SIL/SIS and Functional Safety is considered an advantage. Experience with PLC/DCS systems, commissioning, FAT/SAT, troubleshooting or control systems such as ABB 800xA/AC800M, Emerson DeltaV or Siemens PCS7/TIA Portal is also beneficial.

About us

We are an engineering consultancy with an office in central Gothenburg and a growing presence in Stockholm. As industries transition towards a more sustainable future, we provide specialist engineering expertise to global and well-established clients within the gas, oil, chemical and energy sectors. Our projects often focus on the green transition, circular economy, CCS, hydrogen (H₂), HVO and LNG.

At Nevita, you will have the opportunity to work on large and exciting industrial projects, either on-site with our clients or in projects managed by Nevita. You will become part of a skilled and collaborative team where knowledge sharing and professional development are key values.

What we offer

    

Competitive employment terms and a flexible benefits package

    

Occupational pension, wellness allowance and dedicated time for wellness activities

    

Opportunities to work on large and technically challenging industrial projects

    

Continuous professional development and knowledge sharing

    

A social and inclusive culture where we care about each other and enjoy working together

Interested?

Submit your application today! Applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact:

📧 oscar.sahlin@nevita.se

title: Customs Operations Specialist
description:
Hej Customs Operations Specialist,

Do you want to go to work and help create a better life at home?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Customs Operations Specialist, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

As a Customs Operations Specialist, you’ll play an important part in the team and contribute to a better everyday life for the many. Your primary focus will be to send correctly compiled import declarations using a digital solution in direct contact with Customs Authorities in each country. The impact of our work will resonate in homes and hearts across the world. On a typical working day, you will:

    Control and investigate various issues to secure compliance in securing every customs declaration according to countries legislations.  

    Secure good communication and support to and from other IKEA units, external service providers and authorities within Europe to ensure timely, accurate and compliant entries according to customs rules and regulations.

    Contribute to the development of how we work and reach our goals within the department.  

What we’d like you to bring to the table

To be successful in the role as a Customs Operations Specialist we believe you are:

    Experienced in or hold an education within the field of customs and import operation, logistics or supply chain  

    Familiar with Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel

    Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions

    Fluent in both written and spoken English

It’s a plus if you also:

    Are service-minded with a clear and respectful way of communicating

    Work in a structured way both on your own, in a team and with relevant stakeholders.  

    Find motivation in routine-based work and a process driven environment with a high pace.  

    We are looking for a proactive and self-motivated individual who takes ownership of their work and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.

    A broad professional network within customs, logistics, or relevant stakeholder groups is considered an advantage.

Be yourself, a Customs Operations Specialist, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

Customs Operations Europe & Africa in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approx. 35 co-workers, divided into 3 Support teams. Our assignment is to secure a well-functioning import and/or export process for more than 30 countries in the region, on different levels of detail. We give daily support and coordination in customs related topics within legal matters, goods flow and IT-knowledge to secure availability, affordability and ensure compliance.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We are currently looking for six new Customs Operations Specialists to join our team and welcome your application. We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.



At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs. At IKEA we’re all on the same project.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

title: Produktionsledare Getinge Sterilization
description:
Company description:

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.

Job description:

På Getinge är vi engagerade i att hjälpa våra kunder att rädda liv och säkerställa utmärkt vård. Vi erbjuder innovativa lösningar för operationsrum, intensivvårdsenheter, steriliseringsavdelningar och för Life Science och institutioner. Ett jobb hos Getinge kommer att ge dig karriärmöjligheter som både inspirerar och utmanar.







Om rollen  



På Getinge Sterilization AB utvecklar och tillverkar vi steriliseringslösningar för Life Science-industrin. Nu söker vi en Produktionsledare till vår för funktionsprovning och orbitalsvets. I rollen ansvarar du för att leda och fördela arbetet för gruppen samt för att kontinuerligt utveckla personal, arbetssätt och metoder för att nå avdelningens uppsatta mål – med kunden i fokus.











Dina arbetsuppgifter








    Leda, fördela och följa upp det dagliga arbetet inom funktionsprovning och orbitalsvets, samt utveckla personal och arbetssätt
    Säkerställa att kontroll av färdig produktenhet och orbitalsvetsning utförs enligt fastställda rutiner, med fokus på säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet
    Driva ett förebyggande arbetsmiljöarbete och bidra till att avdelningens kvalitets- och miljömål uppnås
    Driva och följa upp avdelningens nyckeltal inom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och produktivitet.
    Initiera och leda förbättringsarbete enligt Lean-principer och Getinges arbetssätt.







Rollen är placerad på plats i våra lokaler i Getinge, där ditt ledarskap och din närvaro i produktionen är centrala för uppdraget. Du rapporterar till Produktionschefen för siten.















Vad du har med dig



I den här rollen ser vi att du har följande med dig:








    Teknisk utbildning på lägst gymnasienivå, alternativt lång erfarenhet inom tillverkande industri
    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av tillverkningsindustri samt erfarnhet av personalledning inom produktionsmiljö
    Allmän kunskap inom arbetsmiljö och arbetsrätt
    Erfarenhet av arbete i kvalitetsstyrd industri, exempelvis medicinteknik, läkemedel, processindustri eller liknande, är meriterande
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift







Förutom dina erfarenheter värderar vi din personlighet högt. Som person är du proaktiv, drivande och tydlig i din kommunikation. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar för en säker arbetsplats och agerar när kvalitets- eller miljöbrister upptäcks. Du trivs med att leda och utveckla medarbetare och är van att samarbeta med olika intressenter, både internt och externt.



På Getinge omfamnar vi en lärandekultur där vi tar ansvar för vår utveckling och sätter stort värde på kvalitet och samarbete. Framför allt bryr vi oss om varandra för att vi som team och bolag ska kunna fortsatta utveckla världsledande produkter. Vi är Team Players, Forward Thinkers och Game Changers!







Vi erbjuder



Vi erbjuder ett konkurrenskraftigt kompensations- och förmånspaket, inklusive friskvårdsbidrag, familjeförmåner och gemensamma aktiviteter och föreningsliv. Allt detta för att säkerställa att vi stöder ditt välbefinnande och dina mål.



Vi har en öppen dialog mellan ledare och medarbetare, samt mellan teamen. Vi fokuserar på att utveckla människor och tillsammans skapar vi en plan för lärande och kompetensutveckling när du börjar din karriär hos oss.







Ansökan



Ansökningar kommer att granskas löpande och vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-10. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på knappen "ansök nu". På grund av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.



Om du har några frågor angående processen vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på   Emma.paulsson@getinge.com.







Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Vi hoppas att du vill följa med oss på vår resa mot att bli världens mest eftertraktade medicintekniska företag.

title: Account Manager - Mobility Outbound Sales
description:
Please note that this is a fixed-term employment until approximately November 2027, to cover a period of parental leave.THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? A proactive, insight-driven sales professional with industry experience who thrives in a collaborative environment.

Role? Account Manager (Parental Leave Cover) in our Blocket Outbound Sales Team within the Mobility vertical, driving growth and strengthening customer partnerships across Sweden.

Salary? Competitive fixed salary + commission scheme (details provided during the process).

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

Location? Join us in our central and modern Stockholm office, with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely!

Why us? This is your chance to step into a key role covering for one of our team members on parental leave! You will get to make a direct impact in a high-energy phase environment where you can shape our sales strategy, experiment with new ideas, and build the blueprint for the future while growing professionally across a Nordic scale.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    Sales & Industry Experience: Background in proactive B2B sales, account management, or outbound sales with proven results and industry experience.

    Relationship Builder & Deal Closer: Skilled at combining consultative, insight-driven advisory sales for long-term partnerships with quicker, high-volume transactional outreach.

    Team Player: You embody a "team first" mindset and are driven by collective achievements and team performance.
    Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to comfortably use data and statistics to demonstrate clear value and ROI to clients.
    Entrepreneurial & Adaptable: Comfortable challenging existing ways of working, sharing fresh inputs, and finding new golden paths to success in a dynamic, evolving environment.
    Language Skills: Fluent in Swedish and English to build trust with local clients across Sweden and collaborate seamlessly with our Nordic colleagues.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?

Focus on:

    Mission: Step in to support and grow a broad and exciting client base across the entire mobility sector, ranging from small and large car dealerships to sellers of MCs, boats, heavy vehicles, and RVs/caravans. You will reach out to existing accounts while positioning Blocket as their preferred platform to help them unlock their full business potential.
    Daily/Weekly Rhythm: Combine proactive, high-touch consultative calls and digital meetings with targeted outreach to mid-tier and smaller accounts.You will present data-driven insights to show the value of upsell products and advertising solutions.
    Key Projects: Help shape our outbound sales strategy, test new pitch models, and collaborate with Nordic teams to build a unified sales playbook.
    Stakeholders: Externally, a broad and exciting range of business clients across the entire mobility sector, from small and large car dealerships to sellers of motorcycles, boats, heavy vehicles, and RVs/caravans. Internally, our Blocket sales team, as well as Outbound teams in Norway and Denmark.

The challenge to turn into an opportunity!

We are in an exciting, high-energy phase where we continuously test new ways of working and build new structures as we grow. We’re looking for someone who thrives in change, isn't afraid of a shifting environment, and wants the freedom to test new ideas and shape our sales blueprint.

A few words from Ida, Sales Manager:

Hi! My name is Ida Karlsson, and I lead our fantastic Mobility Outbound Sales team in Sweden. We are a close-knit, driven team of five Account Managers who always prioritize team success. Our greatest strength is our ”team first' mindset, and that is precisely the culture I want to continue building with the team. In our dynamic environment, we constantly strive to develop and improve the way we work together. Here, you'll have plenty of room to contribute your own ideas and help shape our processes. I am looking for someone with industry experience and that extra spark to build strong, long-term relationships, a person who dares to challenge existing structures and find new paths to success.

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by the 4th of October, we’re looking forward to hearing from you!

Sales Manager Ida Karlsson is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. Contact information is found in the bottom of the ad.

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

title: Backend developer
description:
About Froda

Froda was founded in 2015 with a clear vision – to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs by making it easy and affordable to invest in their ideas. Today, we are one of Sweden's fastest-growing fintech companies with large international growth plans. We are a creative tech company with the ambition to turn a historically expensive and unfair industry into something ethical and sustainable by promoting entrepreneurship.

Our mission to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs is not only reflected in our products but also in our workplace. By fostering a culture of respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, we provide opportunities for personal growth and professional development. Join us in transforming the banking industry and be a part of our journey to empower entrepreneurs.

About the Role

To further develop and scale our tech platform, enabling us to continue improving the banking experience for entrepreneurs, we are expanding our tech department. As a Backend Developer at Froda, you will be part of a cross-functional team working in one of our product areas — either developing features for our partners, improving our credit systems or maintaining our loan and payments core. For each team, the idea is to continuously deliver customer value as well as to improve the technical structure to make sure our systems are stable and healthy. Together with your team, you will design, build, and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions that directly impact our customers.

You will get a unique chance to be a part of a scaling fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.

Who are you?

We believe that you are an experienced and curious developer who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about building scalable solutions with real impact. You enjoy working closely with other skilled and open-minded professionals and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You are a pragmatic problem solver who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.

We believe that you have experience of:

    

At least 4 years in a similar role, ideally within product-focused teams

    

Programming in C#/.NET with a solid understanding of modern software design principles

    

Working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments

    

Cloud platforms such as Azure (or other major providers)

    

Agile methodologies and best practices in software engineering, including testing, CI/CD, and DevOps mindset

    

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture is a strong plus

What’s in it for you?

At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your skills, and shape your own growth journey. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, lead initiatives, and make a real impact on both our company and the industry. If you're looking to be part of a success story and contribute to something bigger, this is the place for you.

Furthermore, you’ll get:

    

An opportunity to be part of an exciting journey, shaping the future of our company and transforming the SME financing landscape

    

Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm and a friendly culture that values work/life balance

    

We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work

    

Competitive compensation package

    

Insurance and pension plan

This role is all about building the tech that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs —if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!

title: Hotelldirektör
description:
Hotelldirektör

First Hotel Planetstaden i Lund

Vill du leda och utveckla ett hotell med 195 rum och lägenheter, restaurang och spa i Lund?

Vi söker en affärsdriven och engagerad hotelldirektör som vill utveckla First Hotel Planetstaden tillsammans med hotellets chefer och ägare.

Om hotellet

First Hotel Planetstaden är Lunds city-spahotell med 195 rum och lägenheter, restaurang, konferensmöjligheter, gym och spa. Här välkomnar vi affärsresenärer, konferensgäster, familjer och gäster som stannar längre.

Om rollen

Du har helhetsansvar för hotellets drift, ekonomi och gästupplevelse. Du leder ledningsgruppen, är närvarande i vardagen och driver hotellets utveckling tillsammans med First Hotels och ägarna.

• Öka försäljningen inom boende, restaurang, konferens och spa samt stärka lokala samarbeten.

• Leda och utveckla chefer och medarbetare.

• Säkerställa god service, kvalitet och en trygg arbetsmiljö.

• Ansvara för budget, resultat och uppföljning.

Vem är du

Du är en trygg och tydlig ledare som trivs nära både gäster och medarbetare. Du har erfarenhet av att leda hotell eller liknande verksamhet, med ansvar för personal, budget och resultat. Du förstår hur försäljning och god service bidrar till lönsamhet och får teamet med dig när verksamheten utvecklas.

Du kommunicerar obehindrat på ett skandinaviskt språk och engelska. Erfarenhet av restaurang, konferens eller spa samt kännedom om den lokala marknaden är meriterande.

Vi erbjuder

Här får du stort utrymme att forma First Hotel Planetstadens fortsatta utveckling, stärka teamet och utveckla erbjudandet för både hotellgäster och den lokala marknaden. Tjänsten är på heltid i Lund, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan

Välkommen med ditt CV och en kort motivering via mail senast 30 september 2026.

Vi intervjuar löpande och kan tillsätta tjänsten före sista ansökningsdag.

Frågor? Kontakta Thomas Gillespie, thomas.gillespie@firsthotels.com

title: Project Planner - HVDC Service
description:
The Opportunity

Join HVDC Service at Hitachi Energy

HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. The HVDC market for large scale transmission and offshore wind is booming as an enabler for the global energy transitions. All these projects are classified as very critical infrastructures and hence cyber security requirements and standard compliance is very high.

We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don´t meet all requirements.

A team with great cooperation and with diverse background is waiting for you to join!

Your responsibilities

    You will lead planning, scheduling and efforts for all project and tender phases.
    To timely provide the Project Manager, and the Line Managers, with Earned Value Management Analysis, with look ahead, reliable and comprehensive information about the project status: schedule, progress, planned, actual, forecast, resources and productivity, trends, and risks.
    Should have strong scope management skills to drive projects and tenders within HVDC service.
    Analyzes project requirements with project/tender team, checks that all essential work activities have been identified in sufficient detail to serve as a basis for developing realistic project schedules.
    Defines, jointly with the project team, project work and cost breakdown structure, develops and maintains properly linked, required resource-loaded/integrated, baseline and current schedules that provide time-phased baseline, actual and forecast data for the project.
    Monitors project progress and regularly analyzes project critical paths to ensure all critical path activities and project milestones are progressed to the plan, notifies the project team of any deviations or scheduling issues, and provides input for optimizing resources.
    Issues progress reports, program updates and productivity data on a regular basis and as requested by customers and stakeholders.
    Contributes to Sales and Operation planning (SOP) at HVDC Service

Your background

    Experience in planning and/or cost control on lump sum projects or equivalent.
    Thorough understanding of logical sequencing and interfacing of project execution activities in EPC projects
    Ability to lead planning and project controls activities in multi-location EPC projects.
    Experience to plan activities and monitoring execution schedules and physical progress in all project phases.
    Experience in cost management, including cost estimate input from departments, comparing estimate input to experience data, ensuring compliance with time schedule.
    Strong communication skills, ability to highlight key issues and communicate them to management and other stakeholders.
    Team player, with team management and leadership skills.
    Engineering degree and proficiency in English are required, additional language skills incl Swedish is an advantage.

More About Us​

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
    Health care and wellness allowance ​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
    Psychological support program ​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​

Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Eva Schölin, eva.scholin@hitachienergy.com

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer with expertise in automation and full-stack testing to lead quality assurance in our newly formed Gaming Experience Team. This 5–10 person cross-functional team, including frontend and backend developers and Product Owners, focuses on delivering customer-facing features such as personalization, promotions, and lobby enhancements within the Casino vertical.

In this role, you will collaborate with QA specialists across domains to shape testing approaches and define the team’s quality strategy. With ownership of the frontend stack, you’ll have the opportunity to influence end-to-end delivery processes, establish new QA standards, and directly impact products enjoyed by millions of players.
